title: Watch: What we know about Tupac murder suspect Duane 'Keffe D' Davis
english: Duane 'Keffe D' Davis, a former gang leader, is currently facing trial in Las Vegas for the 1996 murder of music icon Tupac Shakur. He remains the only individual to be formally charged in connection with the drive-by shooting that took the rapper's life. During his court appearance, Davis entered a plea of not guilty regarding the charges of murder involving a deadly weapon.
amharic: የቀድሞው የጋንግ መሪ ድዌይን 'ኬፌ ዲ' ዴቪስ እ.ኤ.አ በ1996 የታዋቂውን የሙዚቃ ኮከብ ቱፓክ ሻኩር ግድያ ጋር በተያያዘ በላስ ቬጋስ ፍርድ ቤት እየቀረበ ነው። ለዚህ ተኩስ ተጠያቂ በመሆን በይፋ ክስ የተመሰረተበት ብቸኛው ሰው እርሱ ነው። ተከሳሹ በጦር መሳሪያ በመጠቀም ሰው መግደል በሚል የቀረበበትን ክስ እንደማይቀበል በችሎቱ ላይ አስታውቋል።
oromo: Hogganaan garee yakka duraanii Duane 'Keffe D' Davis, ajjeechaa bara 1996 irratti beekamaa muuziqaa Tupac Shakur irratti raawwatameen walqabatee magaalaa Las Vegasitti seera duratti dhiyaataa jira. Namni ajjeechaa kana wajjin walqabatee himatame inni inni tokkicha. Davis himannaa hidhannootiin nama ajjeese jedhame irratti dhiyaateef yakka raawwachuu isaa haaleera.

title: Where did all the money go if the US is running out of weapons?
english: Recent conflicts involving Iran have highlighted unexpected shortages in US military ammunition supplies. Despite massive defense spending over many years, officials are concerned about how quickly these stockpiles are being depleted. This situation has sparked a public debate regarding where the allocated defense funds have actually been utilized.
amharic: ከኢራን ጋር በተያያዘ የተቀሰቀሱ ግጭቶች የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ የጦር መሳሪያ ክምችት በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ መቀነሱን አሳይተዋል። ለብዙ ዓመታት ከፍተኛ የመከላከያ በጀት ቢመደብም፣ አቅርቦቱ በፍጥነት ማለቁ ባለሥልጣናትን አሳስቧል። ይህ ክስተት የመከላከያ በጀቱ በትክክል የት እንደዋለ ጥያቄዎችን አስነስቷል።

title: Colombia’s far-right government recognises Israeli claim over Golan Heights
english: Colombia has officially recognized Israel's sovereignty over the Golan Heights, making it only the second nation after the United States to do so. This decision was announced by the new far-right administration of President Abelardo de la Espriella, who views the move as vital for Israel's security. The region remains internationally recognized as Syrian territory, with the UN and most countries rejecting Israel's 1981 annexation of the area.
amharic: ኮሎምቢያ በእስራኤል የተያዘውን የጎላን ኮረብታ የእስራኤል ግዛት እንደሆነች በይፋ እውቅና የሰጠች ሁለተኛዋ አገር ሆናለች። ይህ ውሳኔ የተወሰነው አዲሱ የቀኝ ዘመም ፕሬዝዳንት አቤላርዶ ዴ ላ ኤስፕሪዬላ አስተዳደር የእስራኤልን ደህንነት ለማስጠበቅ አስፈላጊ ነው ብለው በማመናቸው ነው። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅትን ጨምሮ አብዛኛው ዓለም አቀፍ ማህበረሰብ እስራኤል በ1981 የወሰደችውን ይህንን አካባቢ የሶሪያ ግዛት እንደሆነ አድርገው ይቆጥሩታል።
oromo: Kolombiyaan naannoo Golan Heights kan Israa'el ta'uu ishee beekamtii kan kennite biyya lammaffaa kan taate yoo ta'u, jalqaba kan beekamtii kenne Ameerikaa ture. Murteen kun kan darbe mootummaa haaraa kan prezidaant Abelardo de la Espriella yoo ta'u, isaanis tarkiinichi nageenya Israa'eliif barbaachisaa dha jedhanii amanu. Haata'u malee, iddoon kun kan biyya Sooriyaa ta'uu isaa Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii fi biyyoonni hedduun kan beekaman yoo ta'u, Israa'el bara 1981 naannoo kana fudhachuu ishee guutummaatti hin fudhatani.

title: Trump demands compensation from Iran as talks on Strait of Hormuz continue
english: President Donald Trump is demanding compensation from Iran for decades of alleged damages, countering Iran’s requirement that the U.S. pay reparations before reopening the Strait of Hormuz. Iran insists that sanctions must be lifted and payments made to restore maritime traffic, while Trump is now asking for funds to cover deaths and conflicts linked to Tehran. These conflicting financial demands have significantly stalled ongoing diplomatic efforts to resume navigation through the vital waterway.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ኢራን የሆርሙዝን የባህር ወሽመጥ ከመክፈቷ በፊት የአሜሪካን የጦር ካሳ መክፈል አለባት ማለቷን ተከትሎ፣ በአንጻሩ አሜሪካም ባለፉት 50 ዓመታት በኢራን ለደረሰው ጉዳት ካሳ መከፈል እንዳለበት እየጠየቁ ነው። ኢራን የባህር መተላለፊያውን ለመክፈት ማዕቀቦች እንዲነሱና ካሳ እንዲከፈላት በቅድመ ሁኔታነት ታቀርባለች። ይህ የሁለቱ ሀገራት የገንዘብ ክፍያ ጥያቄ የባህር መስመሩን መልሶ ለመክፈት እየተደረገ ያለውን ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ጥረት አወሳስቦታል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Doolaard Traamp, Iraan karaa galaana Hormuz banuuf dursee Itoophiyaan kaffaltii waraanaa akka kaffaltu gaafachuu ishee mormuudhaan, ofii isaaniis miidhaa waggoota 50 darbaniif Iraan kaffaltii akka raawwattu gaafachaa jiru. Iraan karaa galaanichaa banuuf dirqama sanadaa kaafamuu fi kaffaltiin waraanaa akka raawwatamu barbaaddi. Wal-gaaffiiwwan kaffaltii kanaa karaa galaanichaa deebisanii banuuf marii taasifamaa jiru irratti gufuu guddaa ta'aa jira.

title: Trump orders fewer childhood vaccinations including splitting up MMR
english: President Donald Trump has signed an executive order to reduce the number of routine childhood vaccinations administered in the United States. A key part of this directive involves breaking up the combined MMR vaccine into individual doses. This decision is based on the President's unfounded claims that the standard combined shot could be dangerous to children.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በአሜሪካ የሚሰጡ የህጻናት መደበኛ ክትባቶችን ለመቀነስ የሚያስችል ስራ አስፈፃሚ ትዕዛዝ ፈርመዋል። የዚህ ትዕዛዝ ዋና አካል የሆነው የ MMR ክትባትን ወደ ተለያዩ ክፍሎች በመከፋፈል መስጠት ነው። ይህ ውሳኔ የተወሰደው የተጣመሩ ክትባቶች ለህጻናት አደገኛ ሊሆኑ ይችላሉ በሚል በፕሬዝዳንቱ በተሰጠ ያልተረጋገጠ አስተያየት ላይ ተመስርቶ ነው።
oromo: Pirezedaantii Doonaald Traamp biyya Ameerikaa keessatti sagantaa talaallii ijoollee idilee ta'e hir'isuuf ajaja labsanii jiru. Ajajni kun keessattuu talaallii MMR garaa gara baasuun akka kennamu kan gaafatu dha. Murtiin kun kan fudhatame talaalliin walitti makame kun ijoollee irratti miidhaa geessisuu danda'a jechuun pirezedaantiin ragaa qabatamaa hin qabne dhiheessan irratti hundaa'uudhaan dha.

title: Iran says it is not concerned by new 'Mecca Joint Defence Agreement'
english: Iran has officially stated that it is not worried about the new security pact recently established between Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Turkey in Mecca. The Iranian foreign ministry suggests this agreement reflects a regional shift toward self-reliance rather than dependence on external powers like the United States. Tehran believes this development represents a change in how these nations approach their own security strategies.
amharic: ኢራን በሳውዲ አረቢያ፣ በፓኪስታን እና በቱርክ መካከል በቅርቡ በመካ የተፈረመውን የጋራ መከላከያ ስምምነት እንደማትፈራ ገልጻለች። የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር እንዳለው፣ ይህ ስምምነት አገራቱ በውጭ ኃይሎች ከመደገፍ ይልቅ በራሳቸው አቅም ላይ ለመተማመን መምረጣቸውን ያሳያል። ተሃራን ይህንን ክንውን የክልሉ አገራት ለጸጥታ ጉዳዮች ያላቸውን አመለካከት የሚቀይር አዲስ እርምጃ አድርጋ ትመለከተዋለች።

Teheraan haalli kun biyyoota naannichaa biratti jijjiirama yaadaa fi mala nageenyaa haaraa akka uume amanti.

title: Houthis launch more attacks at Yemen’s Mocha
english: Houthi forces recently fired ballistic missiles at the Yemeni port city of Mocha. This strike is part of an ongoing escalation in fighting between the Houthis and government-backed military troops. The attack follows a series of similar hostilities reported in the region over the past few days.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በየመን የምትገኘው ሞቻ ወደብ ላይ ባሊስቲክ ሚሳይሎችን ተኩሰዋል። ይህ ጥቃት በሁቲዎች እና በመንግስት ደጋፊ ወታደሮች መካከል ዳግም በተቀሰቀሰው ግጭት ውስጥ የሚካተት ነው። በቅርብ ቀናት ውስጥም ተመሳሳይ ጥቃቶች በተደጋጋሚ ተፈጽመዋል።

title: Syria imposes curfew in Ayn al-Arab after attacks on government facilities
english: Syrian authorities have declared a temporary curfew in the city of Ayn al-Arab following violent attacks on government buildings. Security forces have been deployed throughout the area to restore control and search for those responsible for the assaults. State media reports that the situation remains under investigation as officials work to maintain order.
amharic: በአይን አል-አረብ ከተማ በመንግስት ተቋማት ላይ ጥቃት በመፈጸሙ የሶሪያ ባለስልጣናት ጊዜያዊ የሰዓት እላፊ አውጀዋል። የጸጥታ ኃይሎች ሰላምን ለማስከበር እና ጥቃት አድራሾቹን ለመያዝ በከተማዋ ተሰማርተዋል። የመንግስት መገናኛ ብዙኃን እንደዘገቡት የጸጥታ አካላት ሁኔታውን ለመቆጣጠር ጥረት እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Mootummaan Suuriyaa magaalaa Ayn al-Arab keessatti erga gamoo mootummaa irratti haleellaan raawwatamee booda labsii yeroo manaa bahuu dhowwuu baaseera. Humnoonni nageenyaa nagaa buusuufi shakkamtoota to'annoo jala oolchuuf magaalattii keessatti bobbaafamaniiru. Gabaasni miidiyaa mootummaa akka ibsetti, humnoonni nageenyaa haala jiru to'achuufi tasgabbii deebisuuf hojjechaa jiru.

title: At least 132 killed in Colombia's largest  earthquake in years
english: A massive 7.4 magnitude earthquake struck western Colombia, causing at least 132 deaths and injuring hundreds more. The tremors damaged numerous buildings across several regions, with the city of Pereira experiencing particularly severe destruction and trapped survivors. Authorities have declared a state of emergency to facilitate rescue efforts as the death toll is expected to climb.
amharic: በኮሎምቢያ በደረሰ 7.4 ማግኒቲዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ቢያንስ 132 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፣ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። የመሬት መንቀጥቀጡ በበርካታ ከተሞች ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ያደረሰ ሲሆን በተለይም በፔሬራ ከተማ ህንጻዎች በመውደማቸው ብዙዎች በአፍራሽ ድንጋይ ስር ተቀብረዋል። መንግስት የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ አዋጅ በማወጅ የነፍስ አድን ስራዎችን የቀጠለ ሲሆን የሟቾች ቁጥርም ሊጨምር እንደሚችል ተሰግቷል።
oromo: Kolombiyaatti lafti socho'uun guddina 7.4 qabu mudatee namoota 132 ol du'aniiru, dhibbaan lakka'aman immoo miidhaniiru. Sochii lafaa kanaan magaalonni hedduun miidhamanii, keessattuu magaalaa Peereeraa keessatti ijaarsawwan hedduu waan kukkufaniif namoonni hedduun jala jiru jedhamee shakkama. Mootummaan labsii yeroo muddamaa labsee hojii gargaarsa hatattamaa eegaleera, lakkoofsi namoota du'anii daran dabaluu danda'a jedhamee eegama.

title: Soldiers take cover as Colombia quake flattens military barracks
english: A powerful 7.4 magnitude earthquake struck western Colombia, causing significant damage and forcing military personnel to flee their barracks in Cali. The tremor led to widespread evacuations and reports of destruction across multiple cities in the region. Emergency efforts are currently underway to assess the situation and assist affected areas.
amharic: በምዕራብ ኮሎምቢያ በደረሰ 7.4 ማግኒቲዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ በካሊ የሚገኝ ወታደራዊ ካምፕ በመፍረሱ ወታደሮች መጠለያ ፍለጋ ሲሮጡ ታይተዋል። የመሬት መንቀጥቀጡ በተለያዩ ከተሞች ከፍተኛ ውድመት ያስከተለ ሲሆን ነዋሪዎች አካባቢውን ለቀው እንዲወጡ ተደርገዋል። በአሁኑ ወቅት የነፍስ አድን ስራዎች እና ጉዳት የደረሰባቸውን አካባቢዎች የመለየት ስራ እየተከናወነ ነው።
oromo: Kolombiyaa lixaatti sochiin lafaa hamma 7.4 gahu mudatee, buufata waraanaa magaalaa Kaalii keessa jiru diigeera. Sochiin lafaa kun magaalaalee hedduu keessatti miidhaa guddaa kan qaqqabsiise yoo ta'u, namoonni bakka jireenya isaanii gadhiisanii akka baqataniif dirqisiiseera. Yeroo ammaa kana hojiiwwan hatattamaa miidhaa qaqqabe qorachuufi gargaarsa barbaachisu taasisuuf kan jalqabame dha.

title: Turkiye passes law giving thousands of PKK members chance at amnesty
english: Turkiye has enacted a new law designed to help members of the PKK militant group reintegrate into civilian life. This legislation provides a path toward conditional amnesty for thousands of individuals, provided that the organization commits to full disarmament. The move is part of a broader government effort to promote peace and resolve the long-standing conflict.
amharic: ቱርክ የፒኬኬ ታጣቂ ቡድን አባላት ወደ መደበኛ የኑሮ ዘይቤ እንዲመለሱ የሚያስችል አዲስ ህግ አጽድቃለች። ቡድኑ ሙሉ በሙሉ ትጥቅ ከፈታ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ አባላት በቅድመ ሁኔታ ላይ የተመሰረተ ይቅርታ እንዲያገኙ ይህ ህግ ያስችላል። ይህ እርምጃ መንግስት ለረጅም ጊዜ የቆየውን ግጭት ለመፍታትና ሰላም ለማስፈን የጀመረውን ጥረት አካል ነው።
oromo: Turkiin miseensonni garee hidhattoota PKK gara jireenya idileetti akka deebi'an gargaaruuf seera haaraa baasteetti. Gareen kun hidhannoo isaa guutummaatti yoo hiike, miseensonni kumaatamaan lakka'aman haala mijataa ta'een dhiifama argachuu akka danda'an seerichi ni hayyama. Tarkaanfichi mootummaan walitti bu'iinsa waggoota dheeraa ture furuufi nageenya buusuuf yaalii taasisaa jiru keessaa isa tokko.

title: Seventy years after South Africa’s women’s march, the struggle is not over
english: Seventy years ago, thousands of South African women marched against apartheid-era pass laws to demand freedom of movement. While the country has since transitioned to democracy and granted women legal equality, many still struggle with poverty, unemployment, and safety concerns. As the nation commemorates this historic protest, leaders and activists emphasize that true empowerment remains an unfinished goal.

oromo: waggoota torbaatama dura, dubartoonni Afrikaa Kibbaa kumaan lakkaawaman seerota n,aayoota apartaayidii mormuudhaan hiriira bahanii turan. Biyyi sun gara dimokiraasii ceetee mirga dubartootaa seeraan kan mirkaneessite taatus, dubartoonni baay'een ammas hiyyummaa, hoji dhabdummaa fi rakkoo nageenyaa keessatti argamu. Guyyaa seena qabeessa kana yeroo yaadannu, hawwiin dubartootaa inni dhugaan hanga ammaatti guutummaatti akka hin milkaa'in hubachuun ni danda'ama.

title: Can Netanyahu defy Trump on his Gaza peace plan?
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is facing scrutiny for his decision to reject a 15-point peace proposal for Gaza mediated by the United States. Experts are currently debating the potential political consequences for Netanyahu as he challenges Donald Trump's vision for the region. The situation raises critical questions about how this defiance might impact the future of the conflict and the well-being of Palestinians.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ በአሜሪካ አደራዳሪነት የቀረበውን የ15 ነጥብ የጋዛ የሰላም ዕቅድ ለመቀበል ፈቃደኛ አልሆኑም። ይህም ውሳኔ ኔታንያሁ በዶናልድ ትራምፕ ዘንድ ያለውን ግንኙነት እና የፖለቲካ ተቀባይነት አደጋ ላይ ሊጥል እንደሚችል ባለሙያዎች ይወያያሉ። ይህ እምቢተኝነት በጋዛ ለሚኖሩ ፍልስጤማውያን እና ለቀጣዩ የሰላም ሂደት ምን አይነት ተጽእኖ እንደሚኖረው ጥያቄዎችን አስነስቷል።
oromo: Mummichi ministeera Israa'el Benyaamin Netaaniyaahuu sagantaa nagaa Gaazaaf jedhamee Ameerikaan dhiyaateef fudhachuu dideera. Tarkaanfiin kun hariiroo Netaaniyaahuu fi Doonaald Tiraamp gidduu jiru akkasumas gara fuulduraatti carraa siyaasaa isaanii irratti dhiibbaa uumuu akka danda'u ogeeyyonni yaada isaanii ibsachaa jiru. Akkaataan kunis gartuuwwan lamaan gidduutti rakkoolee haaraa akkamii akka uumuu danda'u fi haala jireenyaa palastiinotaa irratti miidhaa akkamii akka qabaatu irratti mariin taasifamaa jira.

title: Iran war live: Trump claims Hormuz Strait open, seeks Iranian compensation
english: President Donald Trump has announced that the U.S. will pursue compensation from Iran for deaths linked to past conflicts and protests over the last half-century. This demand follows a prior request from Tehran for the U.S. to pay for damages caused by the recent war as a prerequisite for unblocking the Strait of Hormuz. Additionally, Iranian President Pezeshkian stated that Supreme Leader Khamenei remains in good health and is focused on national unity.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ላለፉት 50 ዓመታት በጦርነት እና በኢራን ተቃውሞዎች ለሞቱ ሰዎች አሜሪካ ከኢራን ካሳ እንደምትጠይቅ አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የመጣው የሆርሙዝ የባህር በርን ለመክፈት ኢራን ከአሜሪካ ካሳ የጠየቀችውን ጥያቄ ተከትሎ ነው። በሌላ በኩል የኢራኑ ፕሬዝዳንት ፔዜሽኪያን ከፍተኛ መሪ አያቶላህ ካሜኒ በጤንነት ላይ እንደሚገኙ እና በአንድነት ላይ ትኩረት ማድረጋቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Doolaard Tiraamp akka jedhanitti, Ameerikaan waggoota 50 darban keessa waraanaa fi hiriira mormii Iiraan keessatti namoota du'aniif Iiraan irraa kaffaltii beenyaa akka barbaaddu ibsaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun kan dhufe Iiraan dhiheenya kana daandii galaana Hormuz banuuf Ameerikaan miidhaa waraana kanaan gahuuf beenyaa akka kaffaltu erga gaafattee booda. Gama biraatiin, pireezidaantiin Iiraan Pezeeshkiyaan, hoogganaan olaanaa Ali Kaameenaayi fayyaa gaarii irratti akka argaman fi tokkummaa biyyaalessaa irratti xiyyeeffachaa akka jiran mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Trump suggests escalation against Iran remains a possibility
english: President Donald Trump has avoided detailing future U.S. plans regarding diplomatic discussions with Iran. However, he hinted that the country is prepared to significantly increase military pressure if necessary. He told the media that the specific steps Washington might take will become clear in time.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከአሜሪካ እና ከኢራን መካከል ስላለው የወደፊት የዲፕሎማሲ ንግግሮች ዝርዝር መረጃ ከመስጠት ተቆጥበዋል። ሆኖም አስፈላጊ ሆኖ ከተገኘ አሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ጫናዋን በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ልትጨምር እንደምትችል ጠቁመዋል። ዋሽንግተን የምትወስዳቸው እርምጃዎች በቅርቡ የሚታወቁ እንደሚሆኑም አክለዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Doolaard Traamp hariiroo dippilomaasii Ameerikaafi Iraan gidduu jiru ilaalchisee yaada fuulduraa irratti ibsa kennuuf fedhii hin qaban. Taataus, yoo barbaachise Ameerikaan tarkaanfii waraanaa cimaa fudhachuu akka dandeessu dubbataniiru. Tarkaanfiin mootummaan Ameerikaa gara fuulduraatti fudhatu yeroo dhiyootti kan beekamu ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Trump asks Iran for war reparations in new tit-for-tat demand
english: President Trump has demanded that Iran pay compensation for the deaths of American soldiers as part of any potential peace agreement. This move comes in response to Iran's request for war reparations related to recent military conflicts. Trump expanded his demand to include historical damages from attacks on U.S. troops dating back to the 2003 invasion of Iraq.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ከኢራን ጋር በሚደረግ ማንኛውም የሰላም ድርድር፣ ኢራን በአሜሪካ ወታደሮች ሞት ምክንያት ካሳ እንድትከፍል ጠይቀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ ኢራን በቅርቡ በተፈጠረው ወታደራዊ ግጭት የጦርነት ካሳ እንድትከፈላት ላቀረበችው ጥያቄ ምላሽ ነው። ትራምፕ የካሳ ጥያቄያቸውን ከቅርብ ግጭቶች ባለፈ፣ እ.ኤ.አ ከ2003 የአሜሪካ የኢራቅ ወረራ ጀምሮ በወታደሮቻቸው ላይ የተፈጸሙ ጥቃቶችን ሁሉ የሚያካትት እንዲሆን ይፈልጋሉ።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Traamp marii nagaa kamiyyuu keessatti, Iraan du'a loltoota Ameerikaatiif kaffaltii akka kaffaltu gaafataniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun kan dhufe Iraan walitti bu'iinsa waraana darbee ilaalchisee kaffaltii beenyaa akka kennamuuf gaafachuu ishee hordofeeti. Traamp gaaffii isaanii kana kan babal'isan yoo ta'u, waraana bara 2003 jalqabee loltoota Ameerikaa irratti haleellaa raawwatame hundaf beenyaa akka barbaadan ibsaniiru.

title: Drone targets Libya's Zawiya oil facility
english: A drone recently landed near critical oil infrastructure at Libya's Zawiya refinery, marking the third such incident within 48 hours. Although there were no injuries or physical destruction, the National Oil Corporation has warned that these persistent attacks could lead to a complete suspension of operations. Officials are concerned about the ongoing security threats to the country's energy production.
amharic: የሊቢያ ብሄራዊ የነዳጅ ኮርፖሬሽን በዛዊያ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያ ተቋም ላይ የድሮን ጥቃት መፈጸሙን አስታውቋል። በሁለት ቀናት ውስጥ ለሶስተኛ ጊዜ በተከሰተው በዚህ ድርጊት ምንም አይነት ጉዳት ባይደርስም፣ ጥቃቱ ከቀጠለ የማጣሪያው ስራ ሊቋረጥ እንደሚችል ተገልጿል። ባለስልጣናት በአገሪቱ የነዳጅ ማምረቻ ተቋማት ላይ እየተቃጣ ያለው ስጋት አሳሳቢ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni boba’aa biyyaalessaa Liibiyaa, buufata qulqulleeffannaa boba’aa Zawiyaa irratti weerarri xiyyaara nama malee (drone) gaggeeffamuu beeksiseera. Guyyoota lama keessatti si’a sadaffaaf kan raawwatame weerarri kun miidhaa qaamaa fi qabeenyaa kan hin geessisne ta’us, qindoominni kun yoo itti fufe hojiin dhaabbatichaas akka dhaabatu akeekkachiifameera. Hojjettoonni mootummaa sodaa dhaabbilee anniisaa biyyattii irratti uumame kanaaf yaaddoo qaban ibsaniiru.

title: Opinion: Why the Mecca Agreement is a necessary show of force
english: The article critiques regional powers for their perceived inaction during the ongoing conflicts involving Israel across Gaza, the West Bank, and Lebanon. It highlights Turkey's contradictory role in maintaining trade flows while opposing specific military incursions. Finally, it notes Saudi Arabia’s firm stance on refusing to normalize relations with Israel without a clear plan for Palestinian statehood.
amharic: ጽሁፉ በእስራኤል እና በተለያዩ የክልሉ ሀገራት መካከል እየተካሄደ ባለው ግጭት የክልሉ ሀገራት የወሰዱትን የለዘበ አቋም ይተቻል። ቱርክ ከእስራኤል ጋር የንግድ ግንኙነቷን በመቀጠል በኩል የምታሳየውን አቋም የሚተች ሲሆን፣ ሳዑዲ አረቢያ ደግሞ ለፍልስጤም መንግሥትነት እውቅና እስካልተሰጠ ድረስ ከእስራኤል ጋር ግንኙነት እንደማትመሠርት ያሳየችውን ጽኑ አቋም ይጠቅሳል።
oromo: Barruun kun walitti buiinsa Israa'el fi biyyoota naannoo gidduutti gaggeeffamaa jiru ilaalchisee yaada biyyoonni naannichaa of duuba harkifachuu isaanii ibsa. Turkeen daldala ishee Israa'el wajjin itti fufuun ishee kan qeeqame yoo ta'u, Sa'udii Arabiyaan ammoo mootummaan Filisxeem hamma hin ijaarramnetti Israa'el wajjin hariiroo uumuu akka hin barbaanne ibsitee jirti.

title: Israeli air strikes target southern Lebanon
english: Israeli military aircraft conducted two separate strikes near the town of Mansouri in southern Lebanon. According to reports from the region, these attacks specifically targeted areas in the southern part of the country. No further details regarding potential casualties or damage have been provided at this time.
amharic: የእስራኤል የጦር አውሮፕላኖች በደቡባዊ ሊባኖስ በሚገኘው ማንሱሪ ከተማ አቅራቢያ ሁለት የአየር ጥቃቶችን ፈጽመዋል። እንደ ዘገባው ከሆነ ጥቃቶቹ ያነጣጠሩት በደቡባዊ ሊባኖስ የሚገኙ አካባቢዎችን ነው። እስካሁን ድረስ በደረሰው ጉዳት ወይም የሰው ህይወት መጥፋት ዙሪያ የተሰጠ ተጨማሪ መረጃ የለም።
oromo: Xiyyaaroonni waraana Israa'el kibba Libaanoos, magaalaa Maansuuriitti argamu keessatti haleellaa qilleensa irraa lama raawwatan. Gabaasoota akka mul'isutti, haleellaan kun naannoo kibba biyyattii irratti kan xiyyeeffate dha. Haga ammaatti miidhaan qaamaa ykn lubbuu irratti gahe jedhamee gabaasame hin jiru.

title: Inside a secret launch site for Ukraine’s deep-strike drones
english: Ukrainian soldiers are operating from covert bases in the east to launch long-range drones capable of striking targets deep inside Russian territory. These tactical locations are highly dangerous, as they immediately become targets for Russian forces as soon as a drone is deployed. This strategy highlights Ukraine's focus on using advanced drone technology to counter Russian aggression from a significant distance.
amharic: የዩክሬን ወታደሮች በሩሲያ ግዛት ውስጥ ጥልቅ ኢላማዎችን መምታት የሚችሉ የረጅም ርቀት ድሮኖችን ለማስወንጨፍ በምስራቅ ዩክሬን በሚገኙ ምስጢራዊ ቦታዎች እየሰሩ ነው። እነዚህ የመወንጨፊያ ጣቢያዎች ድሮኑ እንደተነሳ ለሩሲያ ጦር ቀጥተኛ ኢላማ ስለሚሆኑ ከፍተኛ አደጋ አላቸው። ይህ ስልት ዩክሬን የሩሲያን ጥቃት ለመመከት በረቀቀ የድሮን ቴክኖሎጂ እየተጠቀመች መሆኑን ያሳያል።
oromo: Waraanni Yukreen magaalaawwan gadi fageenya biyya Raashiyaa keessa jiran rukutuuf, buufatawwan iccitii baha Yukreen keessatti argaman irraa dirooniwwan fageenya dheeraa deeman hojii irra oolchaa jiru. Buufatawwan kunneen diroonichi erga ka'ee booda battalumatti bakka waraanni Raashiyaa itti xiyyeeffatu ta'uun isaa balaa guddaa of keessaa qaba. tarsiimoon kun, Yukreen miidhaa Raashiyaa ittisuuf teeknoolojii diroonii ammayyaa akka itti fayyadamaa jirtu agarsiisa.

title: Moment of terror as powerful earthquake shakes airport in Colombia
english: A massive 7.4 magnitude earthquake recently struck Colombia, causing severe damage and widespread panic at the Pereira airport. The violent tremors led to the partial collapse of airport structures as people scrambled for safety. Tragically, reports indicate that the ongoing seismic events have resulted in 111 deaths and significant destruction across the region.
amharic: ኃይለኛ የ7.4 ማግኒቲዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ በኮሎምቢያ በመከሰቱ በፔሬራ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት እና ድንጋጤ ፈጥሯል። የመሬት መንቀጥቀጡ የአውሮፕላን ማረፊያው ህንጻዎች እንዲፈራርሱ ያደረገ ሲሆን፣ የነበረው ሁኔታም ሰዎችን ለከፍተኛ ፍርሃት ዳርጓል። በዚህ አደጋ እስካሁን 111 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው ማለፉ እና ከፍተኛ ውድመት መድረሱ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Sokkoo lafaa hammaa 7.4 ta'e tokko Kolombiyaa keessatti mudachuun, buufata xiyyaaraa Pereira keessatti miidhaa guddaa fi rifaatuu uumeera. Sochiin lafaa kun ijaarsa buufata xiyyaaraa sanaa diiguun namoota baay'ee yaaddoo keessa galcheera. Gabaasni akka ibsutti, balaa kanaan hanga ammaatti namoonni 111 du'anii jiru, akkasumas miidhaan guddaan naannichatti ga'ee jira.

title: Ceuta mayor calls for migrant detention amid mass influx crisis
english: The mayor of the Spanish territory of Ceuta is urging authorities to detain and deport thousands of migrants who arrived following a massive border crossing from Morocco. Local officials describe the current situation as unsustainable, citing severe shortages of food and shelter for those remaining in the city. The crisis has triggered significant political tension within Spain and led to public protests from residents concerned about safety.
amharic: የስፔን ግዛት የሆነችው የሴውታ ከንቲባ፣ ከሞሮኮ ድንበር አቋርጠው የገቡ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ስደተኞች እንዲታሰሩ እና እንዲባረሩ ጠይቀዋል። የከተማዋ አስተዳደር አሁን ያለው ሁኔታ ለነዋሪዎች አደገኛ እና ለምግብና መጠለያ አቅርቦት እጅግ አስቸጋሪ በመሆኑ መቀጠል እንደማይችል ገልጿል። ይህ ሁኔታ በስፔን መንግስት እና በተቃዋሚዎች መካከል የፖለቲካ ውዝግብ የፈጠረ ሲሆን፣ ነዋሪዎችም የጸጥታ ስጋትን በመቃወም ተቃውሞ እያሰሙ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Hogganaan magaalattii Ispeen kan taate Se'uta, baqattoota biyya Morookoo irraa dhufanii daangaa qaxxaamuranii magaalattii galeen kumaatamaan lakka'aman akka hidhamanii fi biyyatti deebi'an gaafate. Bakka bu'oonni magaalattii akka jedhanitti, namoota kunneenif nyaataa fi iddoo bultii dhabuun haalli yeroo ammaa jiru tasgabbii kan hin qabne ta'uu ibsaniiru. Dhimmi kun mootummaa Ispeen keessatti walitti bu'iinsa siyaasaa kan uume yoo ta'u, jiraattonni magaalattii rakkoo nageenyaa sodaachuun hiriira mormii ba'aniiru.

title: Al Jazeera reporter on the ground as Colombia quake death toll rises
english: A major earthquake has struck western Colombia, causing widespread destruction across cities including Cali, Pereira, and Manizales. Rescue crews are currently working through the rubble of collapsed buildings to find survivors. Reports indicate that the death toll from the disaster has risen as emergency teams continue their search efforts.
amharic: በምዕራብ ኮሎምቢያ የተከሰተ ኃይለኛ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ በካሊ፣ በፔሬራ እና በمانیዛሌስ ከተሞች ከፍተኛ ውድመት አስከትሏል። የነፍስ አድን ቡድኖች የፈራረሱ ህንጻዎችን በማፍረስ የተረፉ ሰዎችን በመፈለግ ላይ ይገኛሉ። በአደጋው የሟቾች ቁጥር እየጨመረ መምጣቱ የተገለጸ ሲሆን የድንገተኛ አደጋ ሠራተኞችም የፍለጋ ሥራቸውን አጠናክረው ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Sochiin lafaa cimaan tokko lixaa Kolombiyaa keessatti mudatee magaalota akka Kaalii, Pereeraa fi Maanizaales keessatti mancaatii guddaa geessiseera. Gareen gargaarsaa ijaarsa mana jireenyaa diigame keessatti namoota lubbuun hafan barbaacha jiru. Namootni balaa kanaan lubbuun isaanii darbe dabalaa jiraachuu kan ibsame yoo ta'u, hojiin barbaachaas itti fufee jira.

title: Canada flight cancelled after child refuses to wear seat belt
english: A Porter Airlines flight from Victoria to Toronto was cancelled after a young child refused to buckle their seat belt. The crew decided to return to the gate for safety reasons, as an unrestrained passenger could be dangerous during flight. This incident has sparked a public debate regarding parental responsibility, child behavior, and the strictness of airline safety protocols.
amharic: ከቪክቶሪያ ወደ ቶሮንቶ ይበር የነበረ የፖርተር አየር መንገድ በረራ አንድ ህጻን ቀበቶውን ለመታጠቅ ፈቃደኛ ባለመሆኑ ተሰርዟል። አየር መንገዱ ህጻኑ ያለ ቀበቶ መቀመጡ ለአደጋ ሊዳርግ እንደሚችል በመግለጽ ወደ መነሻው ለመመለስ ተገዷል። ይህ ክስተት በወላጆች ሃላፊነት እና በአየር መንገዶች የደህንነት ህጎች ላይ ሰፊ ውይይት እንዲፈጠር አድርጓል።
oromo: Xiyyaarri 'Porter Airlines' kan Victoria irraa gara Toronto imalaa ture, ijoolleen tokko hidhata qabannoo isaa (seat belt) hiikachuu diduun isaa irraa kan ka'e addaan citee ture. Hojjettoonni xiyyaarichaa ijoolleen sun hidhata isaa osoo hin hidhatin jiraachuun isaa nageenyaaf sodaachisaa waan ta'eef, gara dirree xiyyaaraatti deebi'uuf murteessaniiru. Mudannoon kun itti gaafatamummaa warra ijoollee fi seera nageenyaa xiyyaaraa irratti falmii ummataa kaaseera.

title: Colombia’s Espriella to lead emergency efforts following Bogota earthquake
english: Following a devastating 7.4-magnitude earthquake in Bogota, Colombia's President Abelardo De La Espriella has cleared his agenda to personally oversee emergency response operations. The powerful tremor has resulted in a tragic death toll of at least 111 people. Rescue efforts are currently underway as the nation deals with the widespread destruction caused by the natural disaster.
amharic: በኮሎምቢያ ቦጎታ ከተማ በደረሰው የ7.4 ማግኒቲዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ምክንያት ፕሬዝዳንት አቤላርዶ ዴ ላ ኤስፕሪዬላ የአደጋ ጊዜ የነፍስ አድን ስራዎችን ለመምራት ቀጠሮዎቻቸውን ሰርዘዋል። በኃይለኛው የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ቢያንስ 111 ሰዎች ሕይወታቸውን አጥተዋል። ሀገሪቱ በደረሰው ከፍተኛ ውድመት ሳቢያ የነፍስ አድን ስራዎችን በአስቸኳይ እያከናወነች ትገኛለች።
oromo: Kolombiyaa, magaalaa Bogotaatti bu'uu raafama lafaa cimaa (magnitude 7.4) hordofee, pirezidaantiin biyyattii Abelardo De La Espriella hojiilee hatattamaa ta'e kanneen lubbuu baraaruu ofiin gaggeessuuf karoorasaanii haaqaniiru. Raafama lafaa cimaa kanaan lubbuun namoota 111 ol ta'anii darbeera. Biyyatattis miidhaa gurguddaa qaqqabe hambisuuf fi lubbuu namootaa baraaruuf carraaqqii cimaan taasifamaa jira.

title: Europe braces for another heatwave after record-breaking temperatures
english: Europe is preparing for yet another intense heatwave following a summer marked by record-breaking heat, severe droughts, and wildfires. Governments in Britain and France have introduced strict water-use restrictions as high temperatures continue to threaten agriculture and water supplies. Meanwhile, emergency crews in countries like Spain and Greece are fighting ongoing wildfires exacerbated by the extreme and prolonged dry conditions.
amharic: አውሮፓ በዚሁ ክረምት በታየው ከፍተኛ ሙቀት፣ ድርቅ እና የዱር እሳት ከተጎዳች በኋላ፣ እንደገና ሌላ የሙቀት ማዕበል ለመጋፈጥ እየተዘጋጀች ነው። በብሪታንያ እና በፈረንሳይ የሚገኙ መንግስታት ከፍተኛ ሙቀቱ በግብርና እና በውሃ አቅርቦት ላይ እያስከተለ ያለውን ጫና ለመቀነስ የውሃ አጠቃቀም ገደቦችን ጥለዋል። በሌላ በኩል እንደ ስፔን እና ግሪክ ባሉ ሀገራት ያለው ደረቅ የአየር ንብረት እየተስፋፋ የመጣውን የዱር እሳት ለመቆጣጠር ፈታኝ ሆኗል።
oromo: Awurooppaan gannuma kana keessa hoo'a cimaa, gogiinsaafi ibidda bosonaa mudattee booda, ammas hoo'a biraaf qophaa'aa jirti. Mootummoonni biyyoota Biritaaniyaafi Faransaay hoo'a cimaa kana hordofee midhaan qonnaafi dhiyeessiin bishaanii akka hin miidhamneef itti fayyadama bishaanii irratti daangaa kaa'aniiru. Gama biraatiin, biyyoonni akka Ispeeniifi Giriik hoo'aafi gogiinsa cimaa kanaan ibidda bosonaa bifa hin dhaabbanneen ka'aa jiru to'achuuf dhiphachaa jiru.

title: Wildfires burn across Indonesia as officials cite El Nino as a cause
english: Indonesia is currently battling widespread wildfires fueled by an intense dry season and El Nino climate patterns. Thousands of emergency personnel and helicopters are working to control the blazes, including a major fire that has forced the closure of the popular Mount Bromo National Park. Officials are concerned as the total land area burned this year has already significantly exceeded the figures from last year, with peak drought conditions expected to continue.
amharic: ኢንዶኔዢያ በከባድ ድርቅ እና በኤል ኒኖ የአየር ንብረት ክስተት ሳቢያ በተከሰቱ ሰፊ የደን ቃጠሎዎች እየተፈተነች ነው። በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች እና ሄሊኮፕተሮች እሳቱን ለመቆጣጠር እየሰሩ ሲሆን፣ በታዋቂው የማውንት ብሮሞ ብሔራዊ ፓርክ የተነሳው እሳት ፓርኩን እንዲዘጋ አስገድዶታል። በዚህ ዓመት የቃጠሎው መጠን ካለፈው ዓመት በእጅጉ የጨመረ ሲሆን፣ የድርቅ ሁኔታው በቀጣዮቹ ወራትም ሊቀጥል እንደሚችል ባለስልጣናት አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Indoneziyaan goginsa cimaa fi jijjiirama qilleensa 'El Nino' irraa kan ka'e ibidda bosonaa babal'ataa jiruun qabdamtee jirti. Hojjettoonni gargaarsa ariifachiisaa kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman fi xiyyaarri xinjiraa ibidicha to'achuuf carraaqaa jiru; keessattuu, iddoo turizimii beekkamaa kan ta'e Paarkii Biyyoolessa Maawunt Bromo cufamee jira. Bara kana lafti ibiddaan manca'e bara darbe irra kan caalu ta'uu isaa fi goginsichi itti fufuuf waan jiruuf hooggantoonni akeekkachiisa dabarsanii jiru.

title: Turkiye approves pardon-like bill for thousands of PKK fighters
english: The Turkish parliament has passed a law offering a conditional pardon to members of the PKK, allowing those who surrender to transition back into civilian life. This legislative move, supported by both the government and pro-Kurdish parties, marks a significant effort to resolve a decades-long conflict that has claimed over 40,000 lives. While it does not grant a full amnesty, the policy is expected to lead to the initial release of approximately 3,500 prisoners.
amharic: የቱርክ ፓርላማ የፒኬኬ (PKK) አባላት መሳሪያቸውን አስቀምጠው ወደ ሰላማዊ ህይወት እንዲመለሱ የሚያስችል ህግ አጽድቋል። ይህ በገዥው ፓርቲ እና በኩርድ ደጋፊ ፓርቲዎች ድጋፍ የተላለፈው ውሳኔ ከ40,000 በላይ ሰዎችን ለቀጠፈው የረዥም ጊዜ ግጭት መፍትሄ ለመፈለግ ያለመ ነው። ምንም እንኳን ሙሉ ይቅርታ ባይሆንም፣ ህጉ በመጀመሪያው ምዕራፍ ወደ 3,500 የሚጠጉ እስረኞች እንዲለቀቁ መንገድ ይከፍታል።
oromo: Parlamaan Turkiyyee miseensota PKK hidhannoo hiikkatanii gara jireenya nagaatti akka deebi'an hayyamu seera tokko raggaasiseera. Murtuun mootummaa fi paartilee Kurdii biraan deggerame kun, namoota 40,000 oliif lubbuu dabarse waraana waggoota hedduu xumuruuf kan gumaachudha. Seerichi dhiifama guutuu kan hin kennine ta'us, bu'uura kanaan ariitiin hidhamtoota 3,500 ta'an gadi lakkifamuun ni eegama.

title: Trump says relationship is good even as Netanyahu rejects Gaza peace plan
english: US President Donald Trump stated that his relationship with Benjamin Netanyahu remains strong despite the Israeli Prime Minister's formal rejection of a US-led peace proposal for Gaza. Netanyahu publicly opposed the plan, which suggests a gradual withdrawal of Israeli troops alongside the disarmament of Hamas. The Israeli leader emphasized that he would not accept any withdrawal until Hamas is fully neutralized and reaffirmed his opposition to the creation of a Palestinian state.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ፣ የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ በጋዛ የተኩስ አቁም እና የሰላም ዕቅድን በይፋ ቢቃወሙም፣ በሁለቱ መሪዎች መካከል ያለው ግንኙነት አሁንም ጠንካራ እንደሆነ ተናግረዋል። ኔታንያሁ የሃማስ ታጣቂዎች ትጥቅ ሳይፈቱ እስራኤል ወታደሮቿን እንድታወጣ የሚጠይቀውን ዕቅድ እንደማይቀበሉ አስታውቀዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ እርሳቸው በስልጣን ላይ እስካሉ ድረስ የፍልስጤም መንግስት እንደማይመሰረት ኔታንያሁ በግልጽ አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Amerikaa Donald Traamp, muummichi ministeeraa Israa'el Binyamiin Netanyaahuu karoora nageenyaa Gaazaaf dhiyaate mormus, hariiroon isaa fi Netanyaahuu gidduu jiru gaarii akka ta'e dubbatan. Netanyaahuun karoora gareen nageenyaa Amerikaa dhiyeesse kana kan morman yoo ta'u, hidhattoonni Hamaas meeshaa hiikkachuu osoo hin jalqabin waraana Israa'el akka hin baane ibsaniiru. Kana malees, Netanyaahuun mootummaan Filisxeem isaan aangoo irra jiranitti gonkumaa akka hin hundaa'ine mirkaneessaniiru.

title: US appeals court says social media addiction lawsuits can proceed
english: A U.S. federal appeals court has allowed thousands of lawsuits against major social media companies like Meta, Google, and TikTok to proceed. The court rejected the companies' attempt to dismiss the cases by arguing that they were protected by Section 230, clarifying that this law does not provide complete immunity from lawsuits regarding addictive product design. These legal challenges focus on allegations that tech platforms intentionally created harmful features that negatively impact the mental health and safety of children.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የይግባኝ ሰሚ ፍርድ ቤት ሜታን፣ ጎግልን እና ቲክቶክን ጨምሮ በተለያዩ የማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ኩባንያዎች ላይ የቀረቡ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ክሶችን እንዲቀጥሉ ፈቅዷል። ፍርድ ቤቱ ኩባንያዎቹ በቴክኖሎጂ አቅርቦታቸው ላይ ጥገኛ የሚያደርጉ ዲዛይኖችን በመጠቀማቸው ለሚነሱ ክሶች በህግ የተጠበቁ መሆናቸውን ያቀረቡትን መከራከሪያ ውድቅ አድርጎታል። እነዚህ ክሶች የቴክኖሎጂ ኩባንያዎች ህጻናትን ለሱስ በሚያጋልጥ መልኩ መድረኮቻቸውን በመንደፍ በአእምሮ ጤናቸው ላይ ጉዳት እያደረሱ ነው በሚል የቀረቡ ናቸው።
oromo: Mana murtii ol'aanaa Ameerikaa tokko dhaabbilee miidiyaa hawaasaa gurguddoo akka Meta, Google fi TikTok irratti himannaan kumaan lakkaawwamu akka itti fufu hayyameera. Dhaabbileen kun seera ittisaa (Section 230) fayyadamuun himannicha akka dhaabbatu yaalanis, mana murtichaan fudhatama dhabeera. Himannaan kun kan xiyyeeffatu miidiyaaleen kun ijoollee qabachuu fi miidhuu danda'u akkaataa itti fayyadama isaanii irratti qorannoo malee qopha'uu isaanii irratti dha.

title: Trump to demand compensation for Tehran’s ‘conflicts’
english: President Donald Trump has announced plans to seek financial reparations from Iran for US casualties resulting from their ongoing conflict. This decision follows a similar demand from Tehran, which has requested payment for damages caused by the five-month war as a prerequisite for unblocking the Strait of Hormuz. These opposing financial claims highlight the deepening tensions between the two nations.
amharic: ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በኢራን እና በአሜሪካ መካከል በሚካሄደው ጦርነት ለተጎዱ የአሜሪካ ዜጎች ካሳ እንዲከፍላቸው ከኢራን እንደሚጠይቁ አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የመጣው ኢራን በጦርነቱ ለደረሰባት ጉዳት ዋሽንግተን ካሳ እንድትከፍላት ከጠየቀች በኋላ ነው። ኢራን ለሆርሙዝ የባህር መተላለፊያ መከፈት ቅድመ ሁኔታ ሆኖ የቀረበው ይህ የካሳ ክፍያ ጥያቄ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን አለመግባባት ይበልጥ አባብሶታል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Donald Traamp waraana Itoophiyaa fi Ameerikaa gidduutti gaggeeffamaa jiruun namoota miidhamanif beenyaan akka kaffalamuuf Iran gaafachuuf akka jiran beeksisan. Murtiin kun kan dhufu, Iran miidhaa waraana ji'a shan qabateen ishee irra ga'eef Ameerikaan beenyaa akka kaffaltu gaafachuu ishee hordofee dha. Beenyaan kun karaa bishaan Hormuz banuuf akka haala tokkootti ka'amee kan ture yoo ta'u, kunis walitti bu'iinsa biyyoota lamaanii caalaatti kan hammeesse dha.

title: Less than four percent of US safety funding went to Muslim institutions: Report
english: A recent report by the Muslim Public Affairs Council reveals that Muslim organizations received less than four percent of federal safety grant funding over the last nine years. While Jewish and Christian institutions secured the vast majority of these security resources, Muslim groups struggled to access support despite facing rising threats. The report suggests that current government restrictions on specific social and political activities have created additional barriers for Muslim institutions seeking to protect their facilities.
amharic: የሙስሊም ህዝባዊ ጉዳዮች ምክር ቤት ባወጣው አዲስ ሪፖርት መሠረት፣ ባለፉት ዘጠኝ ዓመታት የዩናይትድ ስቴትስ መንግስት ለሃይማኖታዊ ተቋማት ከሚሰጠው የደህንነት ድጋፍ ድርሻ ውስጥ ሙስሊም ተቋማት ያገኙት ከአራት በመቶ በታች ብቻ ነው። አብዛኛው የገንዘብ ድጋፍ ለአይሁድ እና ለክርስቲያን ተቋማት የተሰጠ ሲሆን፣ ሙስሊም ማህበረሰቦች እየጨመረ ከመጣው የደህንነት ስጋት አንጻር በቂ እገዛ እያገኙ አይደለም። ሪፖርቱ አክሎ እንደገለጸው፣ የአሁኑ መንግስት በጣላቸው አዳዲስ ገደቦች እና ደንቦች ምክንያት የሙስሊም ተቋማት ለዚህ የደህንነት ድጋፍ አመልክተው ለማግኘት ከፍተኛ ችግር እየገጠማቸው ነው።
oromo: Gabaasni 'Muslim Public Affairs Council' baase akka agarsiisutti, waggoota saglan darbanii keessatti mootummaan Ameerikaa dhaabbata amantiiwwaniif gargaarsa nageenyaa kennu keessaa kan Muslimootaa dhibbeentaa afur (4%) gadi qofa ture. Harki caalaan gargaarsa kanaa dhaabbata amantii Yihuudotaa fi Kiristaanotaaf kan kenname yoo ta'u, Muslimoonni balaa nageenyaa isaanii mudachaa jiru keessatti gargaarsa gahaa argachuu dadhabaniiru. Gabaasichi akka ibsetti, seerotaa fi dambiiwwan mootummaan yeroo ammaa baaseen walqabatee, dhaabbatonni Muslimootaa gargaarsa kana argachuuf gufuu guddaa keessa jiraachuu isaanii eerameera.

title: Report: US State Department official says Lebanon-Israel talks to resume in Rome next month
english: Mediated by the United States, discussions between Lebanon and Israel are scheduled to restart in Rome next month. A State Department official confirmed that the initial phase of their agreement is already underway, with specific pilot zones currently operational. Despite some political obstacles, both nations are continuing their cooperation through coordinated working groups to finalize logistics and procedures.
amharic: በአሜሪካ አደራዳሪነት የሚካሄደው የሊባኖስ እና የእስራኤል የሰላም ንግግር በሚቀጥለው ወር በሮም እንደሚቀጥል ተገልጿል። የአሜሪካ የውጭ ጉዳይ መሥሪያ ቤት እንዳስታወቀው፣ በስምምነቱ መሠረት የተወሰኑ ቀጠናዎች ተግባራዊ መሆን መጀመራቸውን እና የጋራ የሥራ ቡድኖችም በቴክኒካዊ ጉዳዮች ላይ እየሠሩ መሆኑን አረጋግጧል። ምንም እንኳን አንዳንድ የፖለቲካ ተግዳሮቶች ቢኖሩም፣ ሁለቱም ወገኖች ስምምነቱን ለማስፈጸም ቁርጠኛ መሆናቸው ተገልጿል።
oromo: Araara Ameerikaan hoogganamuun mariin biyyoota Libaanoos fi Israa'eel gidduutti taasifamu ji'a dhufu magaalaa Roomaatti akka itti fufu ibsameera. Qajeelchi ministeera dhimma alaa Ameerikaa akka ibsetti, bu'uura walii galtee sanaatiin qajeelchootni jalqabaa hojiirra ooluu kan jalqaban yoo ta'u, gareewwan hojii gamtaas deeggarsa barbaachisu gochaa jiru. Rakkooleen siyaasaa jiraataniyyu, mootummootni lamaanuu walii galtee kana milkeessuuf walitti dhufeenyaan hojjechaa jiru.

title: Trump asks Iran for war reparations in new tit-for-tat demand
english: President Donald Trump has demanded that Iran pay reparations to the United States for the deaths of American soldiers as a condition for future peace talks. This move follows Iran's own request for financial compensation to help reopen the vital Strait of Hormuz. Trump cited historical grievances, including long-standing militia attacks in Iraq, while also calling for Iran to compensate its own citizens for protest-related deaths.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ለወደፊቱ የሰላም ንግግሮች ቅድመ ሁኔታ እንዲሆን ኢራን የአሜሪካ ወታደሮች ለተገደሉባቸው ጉዳዮች ካሳ መክፈል እንዳለባት ጠይቀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተወሰደው ኢራን የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤን ለመክፈት የገንዘብ ካሳ መጠየቋን ተከትሎ ነው። ትራምፕ የቀድሞ የኢራቅ ግጭቶችን እና በኢራቅ የነበሩ ወታደሮች ሞትን እንደ ምክንያት ያነሱ ሲሆን፣ ኢራን በራሷ ዜጎች ላይ ለደረሰው ሞትም ካሳ እንድትከፍል ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Doonaaldi Tiraamp dhimma nagaa biyyoota lamaanii irratti mari’achuuf, Iran du’a waraana Ameerikaatiif kaffaltii beenyaa akka kaffaltu gaafataniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun kan dhufe Iran karaa galaana Hormuz banuuf beenyaa gaafachuu ishee hordofee dha. Tiraamp sababa kanaaf waraana Iraq keessatti darbe akka ragaatti kan dhiyeessan yoo ta’u, Iran lammilee ishee ajjeefamaniifis beenyaa kaffaluu akka qabdu ibsaniiru.

title: Russia bars only party opposing war in Ukraine from parliamentary vote
english: The Russian Supreme Court has removed the Yabloko party, the only political group openly opposing the war in Ukraine, from the upcoming parliamentary election ballot. The court ruled in favor of a nationalist party that accused Yabloko of receiving illegal foreign campaign support, claims the party has strongly denied as politically motivated. This decision effectively removes the last remaining platform for voters to legally express their opposition to the ongoing conflict.
amharic: የሩሲያ ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት በዩክሬን ጦርነትን በግልጽ በመቃወም ላይ የነበረውን ያብሎኮ የተባለውን ፓርቲ በመጪው የፓርላማ ምርጫ እንዳይወዳደር አግዶታል። ፍርድ ቤቱ ውሳኔውን ያስተላለፈው የያብሎኮ ፓርቲ ከውጭ ሀገራት ሕገ-ወጥ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ አግኝቷል በሚል በሌላ የብሔርተኛ ፓርቲ በቀረበበት ክስ ምክንያት ሲሆን፣ ፓርቲው ግን ክሱን ውድቅ አድርጎታል። ይህ እርምጃ ጦርነቱን የሚቃወሙ ሩሲያውያን ድምፃቸውን የሚያሰሙበትን የመጨረሻ ህጋዊ አማራጭ ያስቀራል።
oromo: Mana murtii olaanaa Raashiyaa paartii Yabloko jedhamu kan waraana Yukreen mormu filannoo paarlaamaa dhufu irratti akka hin hirmaanne dhorkeera. Murtiin kun kan darbe, paartiin biyya jaalessaa biraa tokko Yabloko gargaarsa seeraan alaa biyyoota dhihaa irraa argateera jedhee himannaa dhiyeesse irratti hundaa'uudhaan. Paartichi himannaa kana kan haale yoo ta'u, murtiin kun lammiilee waraana mormaniif carraa yaada isaanii ibsachuu isa dhumaa kan dhabamsiisu ta'uu ibsameera.

title: Trump administration has revoked over 175,000 visas: US State Department
english: The U.S. State Department has canceled more than 175,000 visas as part of President Trump's intensified immigration enforcement efforts. These revocations primarily target individuals linked to criminal activity, visa fraud, or national security concerns. The government maintains that these ongoing background checks are necessary to protect American citizens and ensure that visa holders comply with legal regulations.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የውጭ ጉዳይ መሥሪያ ቤት በፕሬዚዳንት ትራምፕ የኢሚግሬሽን አፈጻጸም ማጥበቂያ ዘመቻ አካል ሆኖ ከ175,000 በላይ ቪዛዎችን ሰርዟል። እነዚህ እርምጃዎች በዋናነት የወንጀል ድርጊት የፈጸሙ፣ የቪዛ ሕግን የጣሱ ወይም ለብሔራዊ ደኅንነት ስጋት የሆኑ ሰዎችን ያነጣጠሩ ናቸው። መንግሥት እነዚህን የቪዛ መሰረዝ እርምጃዎች የአሜሪካን ደኅንነት ለመጠበቅ እና የውጭ ዜጎች ሕግን እንዲያከብሩ ለማድረግ አስፈላጊ እንደሆኑ ገልጿል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa hojii ijoollee isaanii dhibba kuma 175 ol ta'u kan haqe yoo ta'u, kunis tarkaanfii cimaa Preezdaant Traamp godooluu godaantotaa irratti fudhatanii dha. Haquun kun namoota yakka raawwatan, seera biyyattii cabsan ykn nageenya biyyattii irratti balaa uuman irratti kan xiyyeeffate dha. Mootummaan akka jedhutti, tarkaanfiin kun nageenya lammiilee Ameerikaa eeguuf fi namoonni biyya alaa seera akka kabajan gochuuf murteessaa dha.

title: Trump says the US has swept Strait of Hormuz for mines
english: Former President Donald Trump stated that the U.S. Navy maintains full authority over the Strait of Hormuz. He claimed that American forces have successfully cleared the area of any Iranian mines to secure the waterway. This assertion emphasizes the U.S. military's commitment to ensuring the safety of this vital oil transit route.
amharic: የቀድሞው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የአሜሪካ የባህር ኃይል በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት ላይ ሙሉ ቁጥጥር እንዳለው ተናግረዋል። የባህር መስመሩ ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ እንዲሆን የአሜሪካ ኃይሎች በቦታው የነበሩ የኢራን ፈንጂዎችን እንዳጸዱ ገልጸዋል። ይህ መግለጫ አሜሪካ ለዘይት ማመላለሻ ወሳኝ የሆነውን ይህንን የባህር መንገድ ደህንነት ለመጠበቅ ያላትን ቁርጠኝነት የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin duraanii Doolaard Tiraamp humni galaanaa Ameerikaa daandii galaana Hormuz irratti to’annoo guutuu akka qabu ibsaniiru. Humnoonni Ameerikaa daandii kana irratti qophee galaana Iran kan turan maqsuun bakka sana qulqulleessuu isaanii himaniiru. Ibsi kun daandii boba’aa kanaa fi kan biroo eeggachuuf Ameerikaan kutannoo qabdu kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Trump insists relationship with Netanyahu 'very good' despite Gaza rift
english: Donald Trump has stated that his connection with Benjamin Netanyahu remains strong, even though the Israeli Prime Minister disagreed with a peace proposal backed by the United States. Trump dismissed concerns about potential friction between them during a brief public appearance. He confirmed the status of their partnership while answering questions from the media.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ በአሜሪካ የቀረበውን የጋዛ የሰላም እቅድ ቢቃወሙም፣ ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ግን ከኔታንያሁ ጋር ያላቸው ግንኙነት በጣም ጥሩ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። ትራምፕ በመካከላቸው አለመግባባት መፈጠሩን የተጠየቁትን ጥያቄ ውድቅ በማድረግ፣ የሁለቱ መሪዎች ግንኙነት ጠንካራ መሆኑን በይፋ አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Donald Trump hogganaan Israa'el Benjamin Netanyahu karoora waraana Gaazaarratti Ameerikaan dhiheessite mormus, walitti dhufeenyi isaa fi Netanyahu baay'ee gaarii akka ta'e dubbate. Trump gaaffii miidiyaaleen walitti bu'iinsa isaan gidduu jiru ilaalchisee gaafataniif deebii kennuun, walitti dhufeenyi isaanii tasgabbaa'aa fi cimaa akka ta'e mirkaneesseera.

title: Gaza 'Board of Peace' official says plan is still operative
english: A representative from the Board of Peace confirmed that the U.S.-led Gaza plan remains active and continues to progress through ongoing talks with Israel. This statement comes despite Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s public insistence that Israeli forces will not withdraw until Hamas is completely disarmed. The initiative is structured to advance in specific stages, ensuring that all necessary conditions are verified before moving to the next phase.
amharic: የሰላም ቦርድ ተወካይ በአሜሪካ የሚመራው የጋዛ እቅድ አሁንም ተግባራዊ እንደሆነ እና ከእስራኤል ጋር ውይይቶች እየተደረጉ መሆኑን አረጋግጠዋል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ ሃማስ ትጥቅ እስኪፈታ ድረስ እስራኤል ከጋዛ እንደማትወጣ ቢገልጹም፣ ፕሮጀክቱ ግን አሁንም በሂደት ላይ ነው። እቅዱ በተለያዩ ደረጃዎች የተከፋፈለ ሲሆን፣ በእያንዳንዱ ደረጃ የሚያስፈልጉ ቅድመ ሁኔታዎች እስኪሟሉ ድረስ ወደ ቀጣዩ ምዕራፍ እንደማይሸጋገር ተገልጿል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni 'Board of Peace' akka jedhanitti, karoori Gaazaaf qophaa'e fi Ameerikaan durfamuu ammas hojii irra jiraachuu fi Israa'el wajjin mariin itti fufuu isaa mirkaneessaniiru. Ministirri Muummee Biniyaamiin Netaanyaahuu, hamma haamasiin hiikkaa tajaajilaa guutuutti waraanni Israa'el naannichaa akka hin gadhiisne ibsanii turan. Karoorichi sadarkaa sadarkaan kan raawwatamu yoo ta'u, sadarkaan tokko duraan dura haala guutamee fi mirkanaa'e malee gara sadarkaa itti aanutti akka hin darre ibsameera.

title: US Congresswoman Nancy Mace calls Muslim officials ‘threat’ to US
english: Republican Representative Nancy Mace sparked controversy during a CNN interview by labeling Muslim public officials in the United States as a security threat. She claimed that these individuals act as 'Trojan horses' and suggested, without evidence, that Islamic dress could eventually be mandated in American schools. Her comments followed the primary election victory of Michigan Democrat Abdul El-Sayed, leading to a tense exchange with the news anchor.
amharic: የሪፐብሊካንዋ የኮንግረስ አባል ናንሲ ሜስ በአሜሪካ የሚገኙ ሙስሊም ባለስልጣናትን ለሀገሪቱ ስጋት እንደሆኑ በመግለጽ ውዝግብ አስነስተዋል። በሲኤንኤን ቃለ መጠይቅ ላይ እንደተናገሩት፣ እነዚህ ሙስሊም ባለስልጣናት በአሜሪካ ላይ ሴራ የሚጎነጉኑ ናቸው ሲሉ ከሰዋል። በተጨማሪም ምንም አይነት ማስረጃ ሳይኖራቸው ሙስሊሞች በዘመኑ ትምህርት ቤቶች ውስጥ ሂጃብ እና ቡርቃን ግዴታ ሊያደርጉ ይችላሉ የሚል ስጋት የለቀቁ ሲሆን፣ ይህ አባባላቸው ከፍተኛ ትችት አስከትሏል።
oromo: miseensi koongiirasii riippabilikaanii Naansii Mees, hooggantoota Muslimoota kan ta'an biyyattii keessatti yaada balaa ta'uu ibsuun mormii guddaa kaasteetti. Mees, hooggantoota kana 'farda Trojaan' ykn namoota biyya keessatti haala dhokataa ta'een socho'an jechuun kan waamte yoo ta'u, ragaa tokko malee fuulduratti mana barnootaatti uffannaan Muslimootaa dirqama ta'uu danda'a jechuun dubbatteetti. Yaanni ishiinis injifannoo siyaasaa Abdul El-Sayed booda kan dhaga'ame yoo ta'u, ibsi ishiis mormii cimaa uumeera.

title: Migrant children go days without food in Ceuta amid asylum crisis
english: A record-breaking number of migrant children and families have arrived in Ceuta, Spain, creating a severe humanitarian crisis. These individuals are currently being held in temporary shelters where they lack access to essential supplies like food, water, and basic sanitation. Authorities are struggling to manage the situation as the migrants remain in dire conditions.
amharic: በስፔን ሴኡታ ግዛት ታይቶ በማይታወቅ ሁኔታ በርካታ ህጻናት እና ቤተሰቦች መሰደዳቸው ከባድ የሰብአዊ ቀውስ አስከትሏል። እነዚህ ስደተኞች በጊዜያዊ መጠለያዎች ውስጥ የሚገኙ ሲሆን ምግብ፣ ውሃ እና ሌሎች መሰረታዊ አገልግሎቶችን ባለማግኘታቸው ከፍተኛ ችግር ላይ ወድቀዋል። ባለስልጣናት በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ የተጨናነቀውን ይህንን የስደተኞች ሁኔታ ለመቆጣጠር እየታገሉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Godaantonni fi ijoolleen lakkoofsaan baay'achuu isaanii hordofee, daangaa Ispeen kan taate Se'utaatti rakkoon namoomaa cimaan uumameera. Namoonni kunneen bakka qubannaa yeroo keessatti kan argaman yoo ta'u, nyaata, bishaan fi tajaajila bu'uuraa dhabuun isaanii rakkina hamaa keessa isaan galcheera. Mootummaan rakkoo godaantotaa kana to'achuuf carraaqqii gochaa jira.

title: 30 years later, a former rival will stand trial for Tupac's murder
english: Nearly 30 years after the unsolved murder of hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur, former gang leader Duane 'Keffe D' Davis is set to stand trial in Las Vegas. Davis has pleaded not guilty to charges related to the 1996 drive-by shooting, which authorities believe was tied to violent gang rivalries. The trial will examine the historical conflicts between the Bloods and the Crips and is expected to feature high-profile witnesses.
amharic: የሂፕ-ሆፕ ኮከብ የነበረው ቱፓክ ሻኩር ከተገደለ ወደ 30 ዓመታት ገደማ በኋላ የቀድሞው የጋንግ መሪ ድዌን 'ኬፌ ዲ' ዴቪስ በላስ ቬጋስ ለፍርድ ሊቀርብ ነው። ዴቪስ በ1996 በተፈጸመው የተኩስ እሩምታ ወንጀል ላይ ክስ የቀረበበት ቢሆንም፣ ጥፋተኛ አለመሆኔን በመግለጽ ክሱን አስተባብሏል። ይህ የፍርድ ሂደት በወቅቱ የነበረውን የጋንግ ቡድኖች ግጭት የሚዳስስ ሲሆን በሂደቱ ላይ ታዋቂ ግለሰቦች ምስክርነት እንደሚሰጡ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Artistii beekamaa 'hip-hop' kan ta'e Tupac Shakur erga ajjeefame waggaa 30 booda, hogganaan garee yakkaatti namoota beekaman keessaa tokko Duane 'Keffe D' Davis magaalaa Las Vegasitti seera duratti dhiyaachuuf jira. Davis bara 1996 ajjeechaa raawwatame irratti himatamee kan jiru yoo ta'u, inni garuu yakka irratti dhiyaate kana waakkateera. Dhaddachi kun walitti bu'iinsa garee yakkaatti (gang) gidduutti ture kan qoratu yoo ta'u, namoonni beekamoon ragaa akka kennan ni eegama.

title: 111 dead after Colombia quakes leave trail of destruction
english: A powerful 7.4 magnitude earthquake struck western Colombia, resulting in at least 111 confirmed fatalities. The disaster caused widespread devastation, leading to the collapse of numerous buildings. Many residents remain trapped under the rubble as rescue efforts continue.
amharic: በምዕራብ ኮሎምቢያ በተከሰተ የ7.4 ማግኒትዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ቢያንስ 111 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። አደጋው ከፍተኛ ውድመት ያስከተለ ሲሆን በርካታ ህንጻዎች በመፍረሳቸው ነዋሪዎች በፍርስራሹ ስር ተቀብረዋል። የነፍስ አድን ስራዎች አሁንም በመካሄድ ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Kolombiyaa lixaatti lafti socho’uu isaa hordofee namootni 111 ol lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Sochiin lafaa guddina 7.4 qabu kun miidhaa guddaa geessisee mana hedduu kan diige yoo ta’u, namoonni hedduun diiggaa keessatti kuufamanii jiru. Hojiin gargaarsaa fi namoota baasuu ammayyuu itti fufee jira.

title: Lebanon ‘files new lawsuit against’ ex-central bank chief Riad Salameh
english: Lebanese authorities have brought new charges against former central bank governor Riad Salameh and former Bank Audi head Samir Hanna for alleged embezzlement and bribery. This case marks the first time a commercial banker has been implicated in the expanding investigation into Salameh's financial activities during his three-decade tenure. While Salameh remains under medical supervision in custody following his arrest, Hanna has been released on bail as the legal proceedings continue.
amharic: የሊባኖስ ባለስልጣናት የቀድሞ የባንክ ገዢ ሪያድ ሳላሜህ እና የቀድሞ የባንክ ኦዲ ኃላፊ ሳሚር ሃና ላይ በገንዘብ ማጭበርበር እና በጉቦ ወንጀል ክስ መስርተዋል። ይህ ክስ የቀድሞው የባንክ ገዢ በነበሩበት የሰላሳ ዓመት ቆይታ ውስጥ በተፈጸሙ የገንዘብ ወንጀሎች ላይ እየተካሄደ ያለው ምርመራ የግል ባንክ ባለሙያዎችንም ማካተት መጀመሩን ያሳያል። ሪያድ ሳላሜህ እስር ላይ ሆኖ ህክምና እየተከታተለ ሲሆን፣ ሳሚር ሃና ግን በዋስ ተለቀዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Libaanos gorsaa duraanii baankii giddugaleessaa Riyaad Saalaameeh fi hoogganaa duraanii baankii Audi Saamiir Haannaa irratti himannaa saaminsaa fi malaammaltummaa irratti banateera. Himannaan kun qorannoo waggaa soddomaaf Saalaameeh irratti gaggeeffamaa jiru keessatti namni baankii dhuunfaa qorannoo kana keessatti himatamuuf yeroo jalqabaati. Saalaameeh erga hidhamee booda hospitaala keessatti wal'aanamaa yoo jiru, Saamiir Haannaan garuu qabeenyaan wabii galchuun gadhiifameera.

title: Netanyahu’s veto and the limits of American power
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has rejected President Trump's Gaza peace proposal, challenging the U.S. leader's ability to exert influence over his allies. While Trump’s plan relies on a phased withdrawal of Israeli forces, Netanyahu insists that complete disarmament of Hamas must occur first, a condition that could indefinitely delay any troop pullback. This situation highlights a major conflict regarding whether the United States still holds the authority to dictate diplomatic terms or if its allies are effectively setting their own agendas.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ የፕሬዚዳንት ትራምፕን የጋዛ የሰላም እቅድ ውድቅ በማድረግ፣ የአሜሪካው መሪ በአጋሮቻቸው ላይ ያላቸውን ተጽዕኖ ፈታኝ አድርገውታል። የትራምፕ እቅድ የእስራኤል ኃይሎች በደረጃ እንዲወጡ የሚያስገድድ ቢሆንም፣ ኔታንያሁ ግን ከማናቸውም መውጣት በፊት የሀማስ ትጥቅ መፈታት አለበት የሚል ቅድመ ሁኔታ አስቀምጠዋል። ይህ ሁኔታ አሜሪካ በዲፕሎማሲያዊ ጉዳዮች ላይ የመወሰን አቅሟ የተገደበ መሆኑን እና አጋሮቿ የራሳቸውን ፍላጎት እንደሚያስቀድሙ ያሳያል።
oromo: Mummichi ministeeraa Israa'el Benyaamiin Netaaniyaahuu qophii nagaa Gaazaa kan pireezidaant Tiraamp dhiyeessan fudhatama dhabsiisuun, dhiibbaa inni michoota isaa irratti geessisuuf yaaluu irratti shakkii uumeera. Karoorri Tiraamp waraanni Israa'el sadarkaan akka bahu kan gaafatu yoo ta'u, Netaaniyaahuu garuu hanga humni Hamaas guutummaatti hidhannoo hiikkatuutti waraanni hin bahu jechuun murteesseera. Haalli kun, yeroo ammaa mootummaan Amerikaa dhimmoota dippilomaasii irratti aangoo guutuu qabaachuu isaa fi michootni isaa fedhii mataa isaanii akka raawwatan argisiisa.

title: Iran hierarchy consolidation as IRGC veteran tapped for key security role
english: Iran’s Supreme Leader has appointed veteran IRGC commander Mohsen Rezaee as the new secretary of the Supreme National Security Council to consolidate domestic authority. Several other senior military leadership roles were also filled to replace officials lost during the ongoing conflict with the US and Israel. These strategic appointments indicate a commitment to maintaining a firm stance against foreign pressure and strengthening internal military cohesion.
amharic: የኢራኑ ከፍተኛ መሪ ሞህሰን ረዛኢ የተባሉ የቀድሞ የኢስላማዊ አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ (IRGC) አዛዥን የሀገሪቱ ከፍተኛ የደህንነት ምክር ቤት ኃላፊ አድርገው ሾመዋል። ይህ እርምጃ ሀገሪቱ ከአሜሪካ እና ከእስራኤል ጋር እያደረገች ባለው ግጭት የውስጥ አመራሯን ለማጠናከር የታለመ ነው። በተጨማሪም በተለያዩ ወታደራዊ የስልጣን እርከኖች ላይ አዳዲስ ሹመቶች የተሰጡ ሲሆን ይህም የኢራን መንግስት ጠንካራ አቋሙን ለመቀጠል እንዳቀደ ያሳያል።
oromo: Hogganaan olaanaa Iraan, ajaja duraanii waraana IRGC Mohsen Rezaee gara hoogganaa mana maree nageenyaa biyyoolessaa olaanaatti muudaniiru. Muudamni kun waraana Ameerikaa fi Israa'el waliin ta'u keessatti kutannoo fi to'annoo keessoo cimsuuf kan karoorfame dha. Muudamni kun akkasumas sadarkaa waraana biyyattii irratti jijjiirama babal'aa kan fidu yoo ta'u, Iraan dhiibbaa alaaf harka kennuu akka hin barbaanne agarsiisa.

title: Why Egypt held back from joining Turkey, Saudi Arabia and Pakistan's defence pact
english: President Erdogan recently traveled to Saudi Arabia to sign a secretive security agreement with leaders from Saudi Arabia and Pakistan. Turkish officials intentionally kept the meeting off the public agenda to prevent potential outside interference. The decision to finalize the pact was made quickly to ensure the ceremony proceeded without disruption.
amharic: የቱርክ ፕሬዝዳንት ኤርዶغان ከሳዑዲ አረቢያ እና ከፓኪስታን መሪዎች ጋር የምስጢር የደህንነት ስምምነት ለመፈራረም ወደ መካ ተጉዘዋል። የቱርክ ባለስልጣናት ስምምነቱ እንዳይስተጓጎል በመስጋት የጉዞውን መርሃ ግብር ከህዝብ በመደበቅ በድንገት ለመፈራረም ወስነዋል። ስምምነቱ የተፈረመው ውጫዊ ጣልቃገብነትን ለማስቀረት በማሰብ ነው።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Turkii Erdogaan waliigaltee nageenyaa icciitiin ta'e kan biyyoota Saudi Arabiyaa fi Paakistaan waliin mallatteessuuf gara Makkaa imalaniiru. Qondaalonni Turkii, giddu-seentummaan alaa akka hin jiraanneef jecha karooricha iccitiin qabachuun, saganticha saffisiisuun mallatteessaniiru. Murtichi kan fudhatame walii-galteen kun nagaan akka xumuramuufi.

title: UAE's Adnoc announces $8bn gas expansion, as it mulls Hormuz bypass
english: The UAE's state energy firm, Adnoc, is investing $8 billion to boost its natural gas production and processing capacity. This initiative includes plans to develop new export facilities outside the Strait of Hormuz to avoid potential shipping risks. This strategic shift follows regional instability and regional conflicts that have threatened energy transit routes in the Gulf.
amharic: የተባበሩት አረብ ኢሚሬቶች የነዳጅ ኩባንያ አድኖክ (Adnoc) የተፈጥሮ ጋዝ ምርት እና የማቀነባበሪያ አቅሙን ለማሳደግ 8 ቢሊዮን ዶላር ኢንቨስት እያደረገ ነው። ኩባንያው ሊያጋጥሙ የሚችሉ የትራንስፖርት ችግሮችን ለመቀነስ ከሆርሙዝ ስትሬት ውጭ አዳዲስ የጋዝ መላኪያ ጣቢያዎችን ለመገንባት እቅድ አውጥቷል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተወሰደው በክልሉ እየተባባሰ በመጣው አለመረጋጋት እና በኃይል አቅርቦት መስመሮች ላይ ባለው ስጋት ምክንያት ነው።
oromo: Dhaabbanni anniisaa biyyattii kan UAE, Adnoc, oomishaafi qophii gaasii uumamaa isaanii dabaluuf $8 biliyoona liqii ykn invastimantii gaggeessaa jira. Dhaabbatichi rakkoo geejjibaa fi nageenyaa lafa Hormuz keessatti muudachuu danda'u hambisuuf, buufataaleen gurgurtaa gaasii haaraa daangaa Hormuz alatti ijaaruuf karoorfateera. Tarkaanfiin kun kan dhufuuf sababa walitti bu'iinsa naannichaa fi nageenya karaa geejjibaa irratti dhiibbaa uumamee jiruun walqabatee dha.

title: Trump says Iran must pay compensation for those it has killed and wounded
english: President Trump has announced that he will seek financial compensation from Iran for the lives lost and injuries caused by their past military actions and involvement in various conflicts. This statement follows Iran's demands for reparations from the U.S. and Israel regarding regional damages and the lifting of sanctions. Trump specifically highlighted the 2000 USS Cole bombing and recent domestic unrest in Iran as reasons for these accountability claims.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ኢራን በፈጸሟቸው ወታደራዊ ድርጊቶች እና ግጭቶች ለተገደሉ እና ለቆሰሉ ሰዎች ካሳ እንድትከፍል እንደሚጠይቁ አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው ኢራን በአሜሪካ እና በእስራኤል ለደረሰብኝ ጉዳት ካሳ እፈልጋለሁ እና ማዕቀቦች ይነሱልኝ ማለቷን ተከትሎ ነው። ትራምፕ በ2000 ዓ.ም የደረሰውን የዩኤስኤስ ኮል ጥቃት እና በኢራን ውስጥ የተከሰቱ የቅርብ ጊዜ የውስጥ ግጭቶችን በምክንያትነት ጠቅሰዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaant Traamp Iraan gocha waraanaa fi walitti bu'iinsa garaagaraa keessatti namoota ajjeese fi miidheef kaffaltii beenyaa akka kaffaltu gaafachuu isaa beeksiseera. Kunis kan ta'e, Iraan miidhaa irra ga'eef Ameerikaa fi Israa'el irraa beenyaa akka barbaadduu fi qoqqobbii akka irraa ka'u gaafachuu ishee hordofeeti. Traamp addatti haleellaa doonii USS Cole bara 2000 fi jeequmsa biyya keessaa Iraan keessatti mudate akka sababaatti kaaseera.

title: Iran supreme leader names IRGC General Abdollahi military chief
english: Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei has appointed General Ali Abdollahi as the new chief of staff for Iran's armed forces. Additionally, Ahmad Vahidi has been named the Commander-in-Chief of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps. These moves mark the leader's first significant military leadership changes since he assumed his role following his father's death.
amharic: የኢራኑ ከፍተኛ መሪ ሞጅታባ ካሜኒ ጄኔራል አሊ አብዶላሂን የአገሪቱ የጦር ኃይሎች ጠቅላይ ኤታማዦር ሹም አድርገው ሾመዋል። በተጨማሪም አህመድ ቫሂዲ የኢስላሚክ አብዮታዊ ጥበቃ ኃይል ዋና አዛዥ ሆነው ተሰይመዋል። እነዚህ የሹመት ውሳኔዎች መሪው የአባታቸውን ህልፈት ተከትሎ ስልጣን ከያዙ በኋላ ያደረጓቸው የመጀመሪያዎቹ ትላልቅ ወታደራዊ ለውጦች ናቸው።
oromo: Hoggantoonni olaanoo Iraan Mojtaba Khamenei, Jeneraal Ali Abdollaahii ajaja waraana biyyattii taasisanii muudaniiru. Kana malees, Ahmad Vaahiidin ajajaa olaanaa kan humna eegumsa jijjiiramaa Islaamaa ta'anii muudamaniiru. Muudamni kun hoggantoonni kun erga abbaan isaanii du'anii booda aangootti dhufanii jijjiirama waraana isa jalqabaa ti.

title: The Caspian gamble: Iran-Ukraine tensions widen the 'geography of instability'
english: A young Iranian sailor named Nima Moradi was tragically killed when his commercial cargo ship was struck by a Ukrainian long-range drone in the Caspian Sea. The vessel was transporting iron between Russia and Iran when the attack occurred on July 25, also leaving another crew member injured. This incident highlights the expanding reach of the Ukraine-Russia conflict and its growing impact on regional stability.
amharic: ኒማ ሞራዲ የተባለ ወጣት የኢራን መርከበኛ በካስፒያን ባህር ውስጥ በንግድ መርከብ ላይ እያለ በዩክሬን የረጅም ርቀት ድሮን ጥቃት ተገደለ። መርከቧ ከሩሲያ ወደ ኢራን ብረት እያጓጓዘች ባለችበት ወቅት ሐምሌ 25 ቀን በተፈጸመው ጥቃት ሌላ አንድ የመርከቧ ሠራተኛም ቆስሏል። ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት የዩክሬን እና የሩሲያ ግጭት እየሰፋ መምጣቱን እና በአካባቢው ደህንነት ላይ እያደረሰ ያለውን ተጽዕኖ ያሳያል።
oromo: Nima Moradi kan jedhamu dargaggeessi qaqalii biyya Iraan, markaba daldalaa keessa osoo jiruu haleellaa xiyyaara raadaaraa (drone) kan Yukreeniin gahe irratti lubbuun isaa darbeera. Markabichi biyya Raashiyaa irraa gara Iraanitti sibiila fe'ee osoo adeemuu, ergaa haleellaa kana erga raawwatamee booda hojjetaan markabaa kan biraas miidhameera. Kuni ammoo waraanni Yukreenii fi Raashiyaa gidduutti gaggeeffamaa jiru gara naannawa kanaatti babal'achaa akka jiru fi tasgabbii dhabsiisuu isaa kan agarsiisuudha.

title: We are chasing Ebola virus - it is ahead of us, WHO warns
english: The World Health Organization warns that an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading faster than health officials can control. Because the disease was initially misidentified and insecurity persists, thousands have died while many patients remain untreated at home. Authorities are now working to improve diagnostic speeds and treatment access to combat the virus.
amharic: የዓለም የጤና ድርጅት በኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ እየተስፋፋ የሚገኘው የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ የጤና ባለሙያዎች ከመቆጣጠር አቅም በላይ እየሆነ መምጣቱን አስታውቋል። በሽታው መጀመሪያ ላይ በስህተት ተለይቶ መታወቁ እና በስፍራው ያለው አለመረጋጋት በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን ሕይወት ቀጥፏል። ባለሥልጣናት የበሽታውን ስርጭት ለመግታት የምርመራ ሂደቱን ለማፋጠን እና የሕክምና አገልግሎቱን ለማሻሻል እየሞከሩ ነው።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Fayyaa Addunyaa dhukkubni Ebola Rippabiliika Dimookiraatawaa Koongoo keessatti babal'achaa jiru, to'annoo ogeeyyota fayyaa irra akka darbe akeekkachiiseera. Dhukkubichi jalqaba irratti dogoggoraan kan adda baafamee fi naannichatti rakkoon tasgabbii waan jiruuf, namoonni kumaan lakkaawwaman du'aniiru. Bulchiinsi biyyattii amma babal'ina dhukkubichaa to'achuuf jecha saffisa qorannoo fayyaa fi tajaajila yaalaa fooyyessuuf carraaqaa jiru.

title: Oman trying to contain extensive oil spill from stricken tanker
english: Oman is working to manage a large oil spill from a damaged tanker, the Caroline Bezengi, which has been stranded near a sensitive marine reserve for over a month. The spill covers hundreds of square kilometers near the Hallaniyat Islands, threatening local coral reefs and rare wildlife. Authorities are currently conducting surveillance and planning to safely transfer the tanker's remaining oil cargo to prevent further environmental damage.
amharic: ኦማን በባህር ዳርቻዋ አቅራቢያ በተከሰተ የነዳጅ መርከብ አደጋ ምክንያት የተፈጠረውን ትልቅ የነዳጅ መፍሰስ ለመቆጣጠር ጥረት እያደረገች ነው። ካሮላይን ቤዘንጊ የተባለችው መርከብ ከአንድ ወር በላይ በተጠበቀ የባህር ክልል ውስጥ በመቆሟ፣ ለአካባቢው ስነ-ምህዳር እና ብርቅዬ የባህር እንስሳት ከፍተኛ ስጋት ደቅናለች። ባለስልጣናት አካባቢውን ለመጠበቅ እና ከመርከቧ ውስጥ ያለውን ነዳጅ በአስተማማኝ ሁኔታ ለማውጣት አስፈላጊውን ዝግጅት እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Oman do’ii boba’aa markaba midhame tokkorraa dhangala’e to’achuuf tattaaffii gochaa jirti. Markabni 'Caroline Bezengi' jedhamu kun ji’a tokko oliif bakka qulqulluun qilleensaafi lubbu qabeeyyiin galaanaa itti eegamu keessatti caccabee waan jiruuf, naannichatti balaa guddaa fideera. Mootummaan biyyattii qilleensaafi galaana keessa sakatta’iinsa gochuun, boba’aan markabichaa naannoo sana akka hin miine of eeggannoo cimaa gochaa jira.

title: Zuckerberg’s yacht crew did not hear call for help, says spokesperson
english: A small boat running low on fuel off the coast of Alaska sought assistance after failing to reach Mark Zuckerberg’s yacht, the Launchpad. A spokesperson for the Meta CEO stated that the crew did not hear the radio request because they were monitoring a different channel. A nearby cruise ship ultimately helped the stranded vessel, and Zuckerberg was not on his yacht at the time of the incident.
amharic: በአላስካ የባህር ዳርቻ ነዳጅ ያለቀበት አንድ ትንሽ ጀልባ የፌስቡክ መስራች ማርክ ዙከርበርግ ጀልባን እርዳታ ለመጠየቅ ቢሞክርም ምላሽ አላገኘም። የዙከርበርግ ቃል አቀባይ እንደገለፁት፣ ሰራተኞቹ ጥሪውን ያልሰሙት በሌላ የሬዲዮ ድግግሞሽ ላይ ስለነበሩ ነው። በመጨረሻም በአቅራቢያ የነበረ ሌላ መርከብ ተጎጂውን የረዳ ሲሆን፣ ክስተቱ ሲፈጠር ዙከርበርግ በጀልባው ላይ አልነበሩም።
oromo: Mark Zuckerberg, abbaan qabeenyaa Meta, dooniin isaa doonii xinnoo tokko kan boba’aan irraa dhumate gargaaruu dhabuun isaa oduu kaasee ture. Ibsi dubbi himaa isaa akka jedhutti, hojjattoonni doonichaa waamicha gargaarsaa sana kan dhagahuu dadhaban raadiyoo isaanii irratti garaagarummaan iddoo jijjiirraa waan jiruufi. Dhuma irratti dooniin biraa dhiyaatti argamu gargaarsa laatullee, Zuckerberg yeroo sana doonii isaa irratti hin turre.

title: Palestinian club football to restart in September after Gaza war suspension
english: The Palestinian Football Association is set to restart its leagues on September 4 following a three-year suspension caused by the war in Gaza. The inaugural tournament, called the 'Thousand Martyrs’ Cup,' will feature over 200 clubs from the West Bank, Gaza, and Lebanese refugee camps to honor athletes killed during the conflict. Association officials emphasized that this return to play serves as a resilient symbol of hope while calling on FIFA to protect Palestinian sports and ensure fair treatment.
amharic: በጋዛ በተካሄደው ጦርነት ምክንያት ለሦስት ዓመታት ተቋርጦ የነበረው የፍልስጤም እግር ኳስ ሊግ ከመስከረም 4 ቀን ጀምሮ ዳግም እንደሚጀመር የፍልስጤም እግር ኳስ ማህበር አስታወቀ። በጦርነቱ የተገደሉ አትሌቶችን ለማስታወስ 'የሺህ ሰማዕታት ዋንጫ' በሚል ስያሜ በሚካሄደው በዚህ ውድድር ከዌስት ባንክ፣ ከጋዛ እና ከሊባኖስ የስደተኞች ካምፖች የተውጣጡ ከ200 በላይ ክለቦች ይሳተፋሉ። የማህበሩ መሪዎች ይህ ውድድር የተስፋ ምልክት መሆኑን በመግለጽ፣ ፊፋ የፍልስጤም ስፖርትን እንዲደግፍ እና ፍትሃዊነት እንዲሰፍን ጥሪ አቅርበዋል።
oromo: Waldaan kubbaa miilaa Falasthiin waraana Gaazaatiin wal qabatee waggaa sadiif dhaabatee ture erga ture booda, Hagayya 4 irraa eegalee barnoota fi taphoota isaa akka jalqabu beeksiseera. Taphoonni kunneen 'Wancaa Gootota Dhibba Tokkoo' jedhamuun, lola sana keessatti namoota du'aniif yaadannoo akka ta'utti taphatamu. Tapha kana irratti kilaboonni 200 ol kanneen Weest Baankii, Gaazaa fi buufataalee baqattootaa Libaanoos irraa dhufan kan hirmaatan yoo ta'u, ajajoonni waldaa kanaa taphoonni kun mallattoo abdii fi jabinaa ta'uu ibsuun, FIFA mirga taphatoota Falasthiin akka kabaju gaafataniiru.

title: Iran’s president says Khamenei is in ‘perfect health’
english: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has publicly stated that Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei is in excellent health. During a recent seven-hour meeting, the leader emphasized the importance of national unity and cohesion. This announcement aims to reassure the public regarding the leader's well-being and the stability of the country's leadership.
amharic: የኢራኑ ፕሬዚዳንት ማሱድ መዝሽኪያን የሀገሪቱ ጠቅላይ መሪ አያቶላህ አሊ ካሜኒ በሙሉ ጤንነት ላይ እንደሚገኙ አስታውቀዋል። ሰሞኑን በተካሄደ የሰባት ሰዓታት ውይይት ላይ መሪው ስለ ሀገር አንድነት እና ጥምረት መልእክት አስተላልፈዋል። መግለጫው የመሪውን ጤንነት በተመለከተ በህዝቡ ዘንድ ያለውን ስጋት ለማስወገድ እና የሀገሪቱን የፖለቲካ መረጋጋት ለማረጋገጥ ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Iraan Masuud Pezeeshkiyaan, hoogganaan olaanaa biyyattii Aayattollaah Alii Kaameeniin fayyaa gaarii irratti akka argaman ibsaniiru. Walga'ii sa'aatii torba turere irratti, hoogganichi tokkummaa biyyaalessaa irratti xiyyeeffannoo kennuun dhaamaniiru. Ibsi kun fayyummaa hoogganichaa fi tasgabbii biyyattii ilaalchisee yaaddoo uummataa hambisuuf kan akeekkatedha.

title: Colombia earthquake live: Magnitude 7.4 quake strikes near Bogota; 47 dead
english: A massive 7.4 magnitude earthquake struck Colombia on Monday, causing widespread destruction in areas west of Bogota. Official reports indicate that at least 69 people have died, with many others remaining trapped under collapsed structures. Rescue operations are currently underway as authorities assess the damage across the region.
amharic: ሰኞ ዕለት በኮሎምቢያ በቦጎታ ከተማ አቅራቢያ የ7.4 ማግኒቲዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ተከስቶ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት አስከትሏል። በአደጋው ቢያንስ 69 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው ያለፈ ሲሆን፣ በርካታ ሰዎችም በፈራረሱ ህንጻዎች ስር ተይዘዋል። የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች የተጎጂዎችን ሁኔታ በመከታተል ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Dilbata darbe Kolombiyaa keessatti kirkirri lafaa cimaan 7.4 kan qabu biyyattii naannoo Bogotaa rukuteera. Gabaasni mootummaa akka ibsetti namoonni 69 lubbuun isaanii darbuu fi namoonni hedduun ammoo mana diigame jala akka jiran beekameera. Ammaaf hojii gargaarsa namoomaa fi namoota mana jala jiran baasuu ittifufanii jiru.

title: Photos: 7.4-magnitude earthquake rocks western Colombia
english: A massive 7.4-magnitude earthquake struck western Colombia, resulting in at least 47 deaths and significant destruction of buildings. The tremor, which originated near San Jose del Palmar, was strong enough to be felt in neighboring Ecuador and as far away as the capital, Bogota. Authorities are currently leading rescue efforts as survivors search through debris, while officials warn that aftershocks may continue.
amharic: በምዕራብ ኮሎምቢያ በደረሰው የ7.4 ማግኒቲዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ቢያንስ 47 ሰዎች መሞታቸው እና በርካታ ሕንፃዎች መውደማቸው ተገልጿል። የመሬት መንቀጥቀጡ ማዕከል በሳን ሆሴ ዴል ፓልማር አካባቢ የነበረ ሲሆን፣ ንዝረቱም እስከ ጎረቤት አገር ኢኳዶር እና እስከ ዋና ከተማዋ ቦጎታ ድረስ ተሰምቷል። የኮሎምቢያ መንግሥት የነፍስ አድን ሥራዎችን በኃላፊነት እየመራ ሲሆን፣ ተያያዥ ድንገተኛ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጦች ሊኖሩ እንደሚችሉ ባለሥልጣናት አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Kolombiyaa lixaatti sochiin lafaa cimaan 7.4 magnitude qabu mudatee lubbuun namoota 47 ol darbureera, manneen hedduunis barbadaa'aniiru. Sochiin lafaa kun San Joosee deel Paalmaariitti kan ka'e yoo ta'u, biyya ollaa Eekwaador fi hanga magaalaa guddoo Bogootaatti dhaga'ameera. Mootummaan Kolombiyaa hojii lubaba oolchuu gaggeessaa kan jiru yoo ta'u, sochiin lafaa biraa itti fufuu waan danda'uuf namoonni akka of eeggatan gorfamaniiru.

title: DRC’s Ebola outbreak began months before it was officially declared, says WHO
english: The World Health Organization has revealed that the current Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo actually started in February, significantly earlier than the official declaration in May. Initial cases were misdiagnosed as malaria or typhoid, allowing the virus to spread rapidly before health officials could properly intervene. The situation is further complicated by a lack of approved vaccines for this specific strain, alongside security challenges, community distrust, and limited resources.
amharic: የዓለም ጤና ድርጅት በኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ የተከሰተው የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ መጋቢት ወር ላይ ይፋ ከመደረጉ በፊት ከየካቲት ጀምሮ እንደነበር አስታውቋል። ቀደም ሲል የነበሩ የኢቦላ ምልክቶች በወባ እና በታይፎይድ በሽታዎች የተሳሳተ ምርመራ በመደረጉ ቫይረሱ በፍጥነት እንዲስፋፋ አድርጓል። ለዚህ የኢቦላ ዝርያ የተፈቀደ ክትባት አለመኖሩ፣ የደህንነት ችግሮች እና የህክምና ቁሳቁስ እጥረት ወረርሽኙን ለመቆጣጠር አስቸጋሪ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Fayyaa Addunyaa dhibee Ibolaa kanaan dura Kongootti argamee ture, ibsi seera qabeessi Caamsaa keessa kennamee utuu hin ta’in, akka Adoolessa irraa jalqabe beeksiseera. Dhukkubichi jalqaba irratti dhukkuba busaa ykn taayifooyidii jedhamee waan dogoggorameef, vaayirasiin kun saffisaan babal’achuu danda’eera. Gosoota Ibolaa kanaaf talaallii dhabbataan hayyamame waan hin jirreef, akkasumas rakkoo nageenyaa fi hanqina qabeenyaa jiraatuun dhibee kana to’achuu rakkisaa taasiseera.

title: ‘We have no one’: Palestinians react to Israel’s rejection of Gaza plan
english: Palestinians in Gaza have expressed deep frustration and hopelessness after Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu rejected a U.S.-backed peace proposal. The proposed plan aimed to facilitate an Israeli military withdrawal, humanitarian aid, and a new civilian administration, but Netanyahu insists that Hamas must be fully disarmed first. Residents remain skeptical about the possibility of long-term peace, viewing any potential ceasefires as merely temporary pauses in an ongoing conflict.
amharic: በጋዛ የሚገኙ ፍልስጤማውያን የእስራኤል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ በአሜሪካ የተደገፈውን የሰላም እቅድ ውድቅ ማድረጋቸውን ተከትሎ ከፍተኛ ቁጭት እና ተስፋ መቁረጥ ተሰምቷቸዋል። የቀረበው እቅድ የእስራኤል ወታደሮች መውጣትን፣ የሰብአዊ እርዳታ አቅርቦትን እና አዲስ የአስተዳደር መዋቅር መመስረትን ያለመ ቢሆንም፣ ኔታንያሁ የሃማስ ታጣቂዎች ሙሉ በሙሉ ትጥቅ ሳይፈቱ ጦርነቱ እንደማይቆም አሳውቀዋል። የጋዛ ነዋሪዎች ማንኛውም የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ዘላቂ ሰላም ሊያመጣ እንደማይችል በመግለጽ እምነት አጥተዋል።
oromo: Warra Gaza keessa jiraatan biratti, Ministirri Muummee Israa'el Benyamin Netanyaahu karoora nagaa Ameerikaan deggerame diduun isaanii abdii kutannaa fi gadda guddaa uumeera. Karoorichi waraanni Israa'el akka ba'u, gargaarsi namoomaa akka seenuufi sirni bulchiinsa haaraa akka dhaabbatu kan karoorfame ture; ta'us, Netanyaahu hamma Haamaas guutummaatti hidhannoo hiikkatuutti waraanni akka hin dhaabanne ibsaniiru. Jiraattonni Gaza, waliigaltee kamiyyuu nagaa dhaabbataa fida jedhanii waan hin amannee fi waraanni kun itti fufa jedhanii yaadu.

title: 'Total incinerated destruction': Canada wildfire evacuees wonder if they still have homes
english: A rapidly spreading wildfire in British Columbia's Okanagan region has forced thousands of people to evacuate their homes, leaving many uncertain if their properties have survived. Authorities are currently assessing the extent of the damage caused by the out-of-control fire, which has already claimed one life during an evacuation attempt. A state of emergency has been declared as firefighters struggle to contain this blaze and over 100 other active fires in the province.
amharic: በብሪቲሽ ኮሎምቢያ ኦካናጋን ክልል በፍጥነት የተስፋፋው የዱር እሳት በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን ከመኖሪያ ቤታቸው እንዲፈናቀሉ ያስገደደ ሲሆን፣ ብዙዎች ቤታቸው መቃጠሉን ወይም አለመቃጠሉን ለማወቅ እየተጠባበቁ ነው። እሳቱ ገና ቁጥጥር ስር ያልዋለ ሲሆን በደረሰው አደጋም አንድ ሰው ህይወቱ አልፏል። በክልሉ ከ100 በላይ የእሳት አደጋዎች እየተከሰቱ በመሆናቸው መንግስት የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ አዋጅ በማወጅ የነፍስ አድን ስራዎችን እያከናወነ ይገኛል።
oromo: Naannoo Okanagan kan British Columbia keessatti ibidda bosonaa saffisaan babal'ateen namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaawaman manneen isaanii gadhiisuuf dirqamaniiru; namoonni baay'eenis qabeenyi isaanii badii irraa ooluu fi dhiisuu isaa hubachuuf yaalii gochaa jiru. Ibiddichi to'annoo ala waan jiruuf namni tokko yeroo baqachaa jirutti lubbuun isaa darbeera. Naannichatti ibiddoonni biroo 100 ol waan jiranif, mootummaan labsii yeroo ariifachiisaa labsee hojiiwwan gargaarsaafi ittisa ibiddichaa gaggeessaa jira.

title: Sudan’s army chief holds unannounced talks on national dialogue
english: Sudan’s army chief, Abdel Fattah al-Burhan, has held private discussions with various political and civil groups to prepare for a national dialogue conference. To foster a better environment for these talks, participants agreed to stop hostile media campaigns and drop death penalty charges against opposition leaders. They also plan to form an independent preparatory committee to organize the upcoming national summit and manage international oversight.
amharic: የሱዳን ጦር አዛዥ አብዱል ፋታህ አል-ቡርሃን ለሀገር አቀፍ የውይይት መድረክ ዝግጅት ለማድረግ ከተለያዩ የፖለቲካ እና የሲቪል ማህበረሰብ ቡድኖች ጋር ምስጢራዊ ውይይቶችን አድርገዋል። ለውይይቱ ምቹ ሁኔታን ለመፍጠርም በውይይቱ የተሳተፉት ወገኖች በጋራ በመስማማት የጥላቻ የሚዲያ ዘመቻዎችን ለማቆም እና በተቃዋሚ መሪዎች ላይ የተጣለውን የሞት ቅጣት ክስ ለማንሳት ተስማምተዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ የጉባኤውን አጀንዳ እና ሂደት የሚመራ ገለልተኛ የዝግጅት ኮሚቴ ለማቋቋም ዕቅድ ተይዟል።
oromo: Ajajaan waraana Sudaan Abdel Fattah al-Burhan, marii biyyaalessaaf karaa banuuf jechuudhaan garee siyaasaa fi hawaasa sivilii adda addaa waliin marii dhokataa gaggeessaniiru. Mariin kun akka milkaayuuf, hirmaattonni miidiyaadhaan duula jibbaa dhaabuufi himannaa du'aa geggeessitoota mormitoota irratti baname haquuf waliigalaniiru. Dabalataanis, marii biyyaalessa kana qindeessuufi haala mijeessuuf komiitii walaba ta'e dhaabuuf karoorfataniiru.

title: ‘They need each other’: What’s behind the new Syria-Russia accord?
english: Syria and Russia have reached a new agreement regarding the future of key military bases in the country following the fall of the Bashar al-Assad regime. Under this deal, the Syrian government will regain control of civilian and commercial parts of the Hmeimim airbase and Tartus port, while the military sections will transition into joint training facilities. This move reflects a pragmatic adjustment as both nations aim to maintain a strategic partnership despite the significant change in Syria's leadership.
amharic: የባሻር አል-አሳድ አስተዳደር ከወደቀ በኋላ ሶሪያ እና ሩሲያ በሀገሪቱ በሚገኙ ወሳኝ ወታደራዊ መሠረቶች ላይ አዲስ ስምምነት ተፈራርመዋል። በዚህ ስምምነት መሰረት የሶሪያ መንግስት የህሜሚም የአየር ማረፊያ እና የጣርተስ ወደብ ሲቪል እና ንግድ ነክ ቦታዎችን በቁጥጥር ስር ያውላል፤ ወታደራዊ ክፍሎቹ ደግሞ ወደ የጋራ ስልጠና ማዕከላት ይቀየራሉ። ይህ እርምጃ በሶሪያ አመራር ላይ ትልቅ ለውጥ ቢኖርም ሁለቱ ሀገራት ስልታዊ አጋርነታቸውን ለመቀጠል ያላቸውን ፍላጎት የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Baashaar Al-Asaad erga kufee booda, Soriyaa fi Raashiyaan buufataalee waraanaa gurguddoo biyyattii keessatti argaman ilaalchisee waliigaltee haaraa mallatteessaniiru. Waliigaltee kanaan, mootummaan Soriyaa kutaa siivilii fi daldalaas kan ta'an buufata xiyyaaraa Hmeimim fi buufata doonii Tartus to'annaa isaa jala galchuuf jira, yeroo kutaa waraanaa ammoo gara giddugala leenjii waliinii kan jijjiiraman ta'a. Tarkaanfin kun, jijjiirama siyaasaa Soriyaa keessatti mul'ateen ala, biyyoonni lamaan michummaa isaanii itti fufsiisuuf filannoo fayyadamummaa irraa madda ta'e kan fudhatan ta'uu argisiisa.

title: Anas al-Sharif: One year on from Israel’s killing of Al Jazeera reporter
english: August 10th marks the one-year anniversary of the death of Al Jazeera journalist Anas al-Sharif and three of his colleagues during the conflict in Gaza. Since the start of the war, at least 260 Palestinian media workers have been killed by Israeli forces. This somber milestone highlights the ongoing danger faced by journalists reporting from the region.
amharic: ነሐሴ 10 ቀን የአልጀዚራ ጋዜጠኛ አናስ አል-ሻሪፍ እና ሶስት ባልደረቦቻቸው በጋዛ በተካሄደው ጦርነት ከተገደሉ አንድ ዓመት ሞልቷቸዋል። ጦርነቱ ከተጀመረበት ጊዜ አንስቶ እስራኤል ቢያንስ 260 የፍልስጤም የዜና ሰራተኞችን ገድላለች። ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት በክልሉ ውስጥ የሚሰሩ ጋዜጠኞች ተጋርጦባቸው ያለውን ከፍተኛ አደጋ የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Guyyaan Hagayya 10, du'a gaazixeessaa Al Jazeera Anas al-Sharif fi hiriyyoota isaa sadanii kan waraana Gaaza keessatti ajjeefamanii waggaa tokko guuteera. Waraanni erga jalqabee as, waraanni Israa'el hojjettoota miidiyaa Falasxiin 260 ol ta'an ajjeeseera. Yeroon kun gaazixeessoonni naannichatti oduu gabaasan balaa cimaa keessa akka jiran kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Oil prices, stocks surge as Hormuz closure drags on
english: Global oil prices and energy stocks have climbed significantly as the ongoing closure of the Strait of Hormuz continues to create uncertainty. Although U.S. fuel costs recently dropped slightly, analysts warn that prices may rise again if the waterway remains shut due to geopolitical tensions between Iran and the U.S. Investors are closely monitoring the situation as hopes for a quick resolution begin to fade.
